0.en: b. The Ethical Action. Human and Divine Knowing, Guilt and Fate
0.zh: b. 伦理行动。人的知识与神的知识，罪过与命运

en: But as the opposition in this realm is constituted, self-consciousness has not yet appeared in its right as single individuality; in it, individuality counts on the one side only as universal will, on the other as the blood of the family; this single individual counts only as the unreal shadow.
– No deed has yet been committed; but the deed is the actual self.
– It disturbs the calm organization and movement of the ethical world.

What in this realm appears as the order and agreement of its two essences, of which the one proves and completes the other, becomes through the deed a transition of opposites, in which each proves itself much more as the nullity of itself and of the other than as the confirmation; – it becomes the negative movement or the eternal necessity of terrible fate, which swallows up the divine as well as the human law, and also the two self-consciousnesses in which these powers have their determinate being, into the abyss of its simplicity – and passes over, for us, into the absolute being-for-itself of the purely single self-consciousness.
zh: 不过，这个领域里的对立是怎样的情形，自我意识也就还没有作为单个的个体性而以自己的权利出现；这种个体性在其中一方面只算作普遍意志，另一方面只算作家庭的血亲；而这个个别者只算作那不现实的影子。
——还没有任何行为被做出来；但行为才是那现实的自我。
——它扰乱了伦理世界那安宁的组织和运动。

在这个世界里表现为它的两个本质的秩序和一致的东西——这两个本质中，一个验证并补全另一个——，通过行为就变成一种对立者的过渡，在这种过渡中，每一个与其说证明自己是验证，不如说证明了自己和另一个的虚无；——它变成那否定性的运动，或者说那可怕命运的永恒必然性，这种必然性把神的法则和人的法则以及这些势力在其中拥有自己定在的那两个自我意识都吞入它那单纯性的深渊——并且对我们来说过渡为纯粹单个的自我意识的绝对自为存在。

en: The ground from which this movement sets out and on which it proceeds is the realm of ethical life; but the activity of this movement is self-consciousness.
As ethical consciousness it is the simple, pure direction toward the ethical essence or duty.
No arbitrariness and likewise no struggle, no indecision is in it, since the giving and the testing of the laws has been given up; rather, the ethical essence is for it the immediate, the unwavering.
The contradiction-less.

There is therefore no bad spectacle of finding oneself in a collision of passion and duty, nor anything comic in finding oneself in a collision of duty with duty – a collision that in content is the same as that between passion and duty; for passion is just as capable of being represented as duty, because duty, as consciousness withdraws from its immediate substantial essence into itself, becomes the formally universal, into which every content fits equally well, as emerged above.

But the collision of duties is comic, because it expresses the contradiction, namely that of an opposed absolute, hence expresses the absolute and immediately the nullity of this so-called absolute or duty.
– But ethical consciousness knows what it has to do and is decided as to whether it belongs to the divine or to the human law.

This immediacy of its decidedness is a being-in-itself and therefore has at the same time the meaning of a natural being, as we have seen; it is nature, not the contingency of circumstances or of choice, that assigns the one sex to the one law and the other to the other, – or conversely, the two ethical powers themselves give themselves their individual determinate being and realization in the two sexes.
zh: 这个运动由之出发、并在其上进行的根据，就是伦理的王国；但这个运动的活动却是自我意识。
作为伦理的意识，它就是那指向伦理本质或义务的单纯而纯粹的方向。
在它里面既没有任意，也同样没有斗争，没有犹豫不决，因为给出法则和审查法则已经被放弃，相反，伦理本质对它来说是那直接的、不可动摇的东西。
无矛盾的东西。
因此并没有那种糟糕的景象，即发现自己处在激情与义务的冲突之中，也没有那种可笑之处，即发现自己处在义务与义务的冲突之中——这样一种冲突，在内容上和激情与义务之间的冲突是同一个东西；因为激情同样能够被表象为义务，这是由于，当意识从它那直接的实体性本质中退回自身时，义务就变成了形式上普遍的东西，任何内容都同样合适地装进其中，正如上面已经得出的结果。
但种种义务的冲突却是可笑的，因为它表达出矛盾，即一个对立着的绝对者的矛盾，因而表达出绝对者，并且直接表达出这个所谓绝对者或义务的虚无。
——但伦理的意识知道自己该做什么，并且已经作出决断：自己究竟属于神的法则还是人的法则。
这种决断的直接性是一种自在存在，因此同时具有一种自然存在的意义，正如我们已经看到的；是自然，而不是环境或者选择的偶然性，把一个性别分派给一种法则，把另一个性别分派给另一种法则，——或者反过来说，两种伦理的势力本身就在两个性别那里给自己取得了个别的定在和实现。

en: By this, now — that on the one hand ethical life essentially consists in this immediate decidedness and therefore for consciousness only the one law is the essence, and on the other hand that the ethical powers are actual in the self of consciousness — they receive the meaning of excluding themselves and being opposed to one another; in self-consciousness they are for themselves, as in the realm of ethical life they are only in themselves.

Ethical consciousness, because it is decided for one of them, is essentially character; the essence of both is not the same for it; the opposition therefore appears as an unhappy collision of duty only with rightless actuality.
Ethical consciousness is, as self-consciousness, in this opposition, and as such it at the same time aims to subject this opposed actuality by force to the law to which it belongs, or to deceive it.

Since it sees the right only on its side and the wrong on the other, of the two, that one which belongs to the divine law sees on the other side human contingent violence, while that which is allotted to the human law sees on the other the obstinacy and disobedience of inner being-for-itself; for the commands of the government are the universal, day-lit public sense; but the will of the other law is the subterranean sense closed into the inner, which in its determinate being appears as the will of singularity and, in contradiction with the first, is crime.
zh: 由于这一点：一方面伦理本质上在于这种直接的决断，因此对意识来说只有一种法则是本质，另一方面，那些伦理的势力在意识的自我中是现实的，它们就获得了这样的意义：互相排斥、互相对立；它们在自我意识中是自为的，正如它们在伦理的王国里只是自在的。
伦理的意识，由于它决定了自己属于两者中的一个，本质上就是性格；对它来说，两者的本质并不是同一个；因此，这种对立就表现为义务仅仅与无权利的现实性之间的不幸冲突。
伦理的意识作为自我意识就处在这种对立之中，而作为这样的意识，它同时还要用暴力把这种对立着的现实性置于它所归属的那种法则之下，或者把它欺骗。
由于它只在自己这一方看到权利，而在另一方看到不义，所以两者中那个属于神的法则的一方，在另一方看到的是人的偶然暴力，而那个被分派给人的法则的一方，在另一方看到的则是内在自为存在的固执和不顺从；因为政府的命令就是那普遍的、摆在白昼之下的公共意义；而另一种法则的意志则是那地下的、锁闭在内部的意义，这种意义在它的定在中作为个别性的意志而出现，并且在同第一种意义的矛盾中就是罪行。

en: Thereby there arises in consciousness the opposition of the known and the unknown, as in substance [that] of the conscious and the unconscious, and the absolute right of ethical self-consciousness comes into strife with the divine right of the essence.

For self-consciousness as consciousness, objective actuality as such has essence; but according to its substance it is the unity of itself and of this opposed element, and ethical self-consciousness is the consciousness of substance; the object, as opposed to self-consciousness, has therefore entirely lost the meaning of having essence for itself.
As the spheres in which it is only a thing have long since vanished, so too these spheres in which consciousness fixes something out of itself and makes a single moment into the essence.
Against such one-sidedness actuality has a power of its own; it stands in league with truth against consciousness and only thereby presents to it what truth is.

But ethical consciousness has drunk from the cup of absolute substance the forgetfulness of all one-sidedness of being-for-itself, of its purposes and peculiar concepts, and has therefore in this Stygian water at the same time drowned all its own essentiality and the independent significance of objective actuality.

Its absolute right is therefore that, in acting according to the ethical law, it find in this realization nothing other than the accomplishment of this law itself, and that the deed show nothing other than what the ethical doing is.
– The ethical, as the absolute essence and the absolute power at the same time, can suffer no perversion of its content.

If it were only the absolute essence without the power, it could undergo a perversion through individuality; but this, as ethical consciousness, has renounced perverting with the giving up of one-sided being-for-itself; just as conversely the mere power would be perverted by the essence if it were still such a being-for-itself.

For the sake of this unity, individuality is the pure form of substance, which is the content, and the doing is the transition out of thought into actuality, only as the movement of an essence-less opposition whose moments have no particular content and essence distinct from one another.
The absolute right of ethical consciousness is therefore that the deed, the shape of its actuality, be nothing other than what it knows.
zh: 由此，在意识那里就产生了被知的东西与未被知的东西之间的对立，正如在实体那里是有意识的东西与无意识的东西之间的对立，而伦理的自我意识的绝对权利也就与本质的神的权利陷入了争执。
对作为意识的自我意识来说，对象性的现实性本身是有本质的；但按照它的实体来说，它是它自身与这个对立者的统一，而伦理的自我意识就是实体的意识；因此，对象作为与自我意识相对立的东西，已经彻底失去了自为地拥有本质这一意义。
正如它只是一个物的那些领域早已消失了一样，意识在其中从自身出发固定某种东西、并把一个单个的环节变成本质的这些领域，也同样如此。
针对这种片面性，现实性有一种自己的力；它与真理结盟来反对意识，并且这才向意识呈现出真理是什么。
但伦理的意识却从绝对实体的杯盏里饮下了对自为存在、对它的目的和它特有的概念的一切片面性的遗忘，因此同时在这斯提克斯河水里淹没了它自己的一切本质性和对象性现实的独立意义。
因此，它的绝对权利就是：当它按照伦理的法则行动时，在这种实现中除了这法则本身的完成之外找不到任何别的东西，而行为所显示的也无非就是伦理的行动。
——伦理的东西，作为绝对本质同时又是绝对势力，不可能遭受自己内容的任何颠倒。
如果它只是绝对本质而没有势力，那它就可能经受一种来自个体性的颠倒；但个体性作为伦理的意识，已经随着放弃片面的自为存在而弃绝了颠倒；正如反过来，如果单纯的势力还是这样一种自为存在，它就会被本质所颠倒。
由于这种统一，个体性就是实体的纯粹形式，而实体就是内容，行动则是从思想到现实性的过渡，只不过是那种无本质的对立的运动，这种对立的各个环节并没有特殊的、彼此不同的内容和本质性。
因此，伦理意识的绝对权利就是：行为，即它现实性的形态，无非就是它所知道的东西。

en: But the ethical essence has split itself into two laws, and consciousness, as an undivided relation to the law, is allotted to only one of them.

Just as this simple consciousness insists on the absolute right that the essence has appeared to it as ethical, as it is in itself, so this essence insists on the right of its reality, or on being doubled.

But this right of the essence does not at the same time stand over against self-consciousness in such a way that it would be somewhere else; rather it is self-consciousness's own essence; in it alone does it have its determinate being and its power, and its opposite is the deed of the latter.
For this [self-consciousness], precisely in that it is as self and strides to the deed, raises itself out of simple immediacy and itself posits the division.

Through the deed it gives up the determinacy of ethical life, that of being the simple certainty of immediate truth, and posits the division of itself within itself into the active element and into the opposing actuality that is negative for it.
It thus becomes guilt through the deed.

For it is its doing, and the doing is its ownmost essence; and guilt also receives the meaning of crime: for as simple ethical consciousness it has turned to the one law, but has renounced the other and injures it through its deed.

– Guilt is not the indifferent, double-meaning essence in the sense that the deed, as it actually lies open in the day, could be the doing of its self or also could not be, as if with the doing something external and contingent could be linked that did not belong to the doing, from which side the doing would thus be innocent.
Rather the doing is itself this division: to set itself for itself and, over against this, a foreign external actuality; that such a one is, belongs to the doing itself and is through it.
Innocent therefore is only non-doing, like the being of a stone, not even that of a child.

– But as regards content, the ethical action has the moment of crime about it, because it does not sublate the natural distribution of the two laws to the two sexes, but rather remains, as an undivided direction toward the law, within natural immediacy, and with its doing makes this one-sidedness into guilt: to grasp only the one of the sides of the essence and to comport itself negatively against the other, i.e. to injure it.

Where in universal ethical life guilt and crime, doing and acting fall, will be expressed more determinately afterward; so much is immediately evident, that it is not this single individual who acts and is guilty; for he, as this self, is only the unreal shadow, or he is only as universal self, and individuality is purely the formal moment of doing in general, and the content [are] the laws and customs and, determined for the single individual, those of his estate; he is the substance as genus, which through its determinacy indeed becomes species, but the species remains at the same time the universal of the genus.

Within the people, self-consciousness descends from the universal only to particularity, not to single individuality, which in its doing posits an excluding self, a reality negative to itself; rather its acting is grounded in the sure trust in the whole, in which nothing foreign, no fear nor hostility mixes in.
zh: 但伦理本质已经把自身分裂为两种法则，而意识作为对法则的一种未分裂的关系，只被分派给其中一种。
正如这个简单的意识坚持那条绝对的权利，即本质已经向作为伦理意识的它显现，如同本质自在的那样，这个本质也坚持它的实在性的权利，即坚持自己是双重的。
但本质的这种权利同时并不作为某种在别处存在的东西而与自我意识相对立，相反它就是自我意识自己的本质；它只有在这里才有自己的定在和自己的势力，而它的对立面就是后者的行为。
因为它恰恰在它作为自我而存在并迈向行为时，把自身从简单的直接性中提升出来，并且自己设定了分裂。
它通过行为放弃了伦理的规定性，即放弃成为直接真理的单纯确定性，并且设定了自身之内的分裂，即分裂为能动的方面和与它相对立的、对它来说是否定的现实性。
所以它通过行为变成了罪过。
因为它就是它的作为，而作为是它最本己的本质；罪过也获得了罪行的含义：因为作为简单的伦理意识，它转向了一种法则，却弃绝了另一种法则，并且通过自己的行为伤害了这种法则。
——罪过并不是那种无关紧要的、有双重含义的本质，仿佛行为，如同它现实地摆在光天化日之下那样，可以是它的自我的作为，也可以不是，就好像与作为可以联结上某种外在的和偶然的东西，而这些东西并不属于作为，从这一方面看作为因此就会是无罪的。
相反，行动本身就是这种分裂：把自身设定为自为的，并且在这个自为的自身对面设定一个陌生的、外在的现实性；有这样一个现实性，这属于行动本身，并且是通过行动才有的。
因此，无罪的只有不作为，就像一块石头的存在，连一个孩子的存在都不是。
——但从内容上看，伦理行动自身带有罪行的环节，因为它并不扬弃两种法则在两个性别之间的自然分配，反而作为对法则的未分裂的指向而留在自然的直接性之内，并且以它的作为把这种片面性变成罪过：只抓住本质的诸方面中的一个方面，而对另一个方面采取否定的态度，也就是说，伤害它。
罪过和罪行、作为和行动在普遍的伦理生活中落在何处，以后会更确切地表达出来；直接明了的是这样一点：行动和有罪的并不是这个单个的人；因为作为这个自我，他只是那个非现实的阴影，或者说，他只是作为普遍的自我，而个体性纯粹是一般作为的形式环节，内容[则]是各种法则和习俗，并且就单个的人而言，被规定为他那个等级的法则和习俗；他是作为类的实体，这实体通过自己的规定性虽然变成了种，但种同时仍然是类的普遍东西。
在民族内部，自我意识从普遍东西只下降到特殊性，而不到达单个的个体性，这种个体性在它的行动中设定一个排他的自我，一个对自己否定的现实性；相反，它的行动依据的是对整体的可靠信任，在其中不掺杂任何陌生的东西，不掺杂恐惧，也不掺杂敌意。

en: Ethical self-consciousness now experiences the developed nature of actual acting in its deed, both when it gave itself over to the divine law and when it gave itself over to the human law.
The law that is open to it is in essence linked with the opposed one; the essence is the unity of both; but the deed has carried out only the one, against the other.
But, linked in essence with this one, the fulfilment of the one calls forth the other — and calls it forth as what the deed made it: an injured and now hostile essence demanding revenge.
For acting, only the one side of the resolution in general lies in the day; but it is in itself the negative that sets over against itself an other, something foreign to it as knowing.

Actuality therefore keeps the other side, foreign to knowing, hidden within itself and does not show itself to consciousness as it is in and for itself, — does not show to the son the father in his insulter whom he strikes down, — does not show the mother in the queen whom he takes to wife.

For ethical self-consciousness a light-shunning power thus lies in wait, which breaks out only once the deed has happened and seizes it at the deed; for the accomplished deed is the sublated opposition of the knowing self and the actuality standing over against it.

The one acting cannot disown the crime and its guilt; the deed is this: to move the unmoved and to bring forth what is closed up only in possibility, and thereby to link the unconscious with the conscious, the non-existent with being.

In this truth, then, the deed steps into the sun, — as something in which a conscious element is bound to an unconscious one, the own to a foreign, as the divided essence whose other side consciousness experiences, and experiences also as its own, but as the power injured by it and hostilely aroused.
zh: 伦理的自我意识现在在自己的行为上经验到现实的行动那已经展开了的本性，无论它是投身于神的法则，还是投身于人的法则。
对它来说公开的法则在本质中与相反的法则联结在一起；本质是两者的统一；但行为只实行了其中一个，用它来对抗另一个。
但在本质中与这一个相联结，对其中一个的履行就唤起了另一个，并且是把它作为行为所造成的那种东西唤起的：一个受了伤害、如今充满敌意、要求复仇的本质。
对行动来说，一般决断只有一面摆在光天化日之下；但决断就其自身而言是否定者，它把某种他者、某种对作为知的它来说陌生的东西摆在对面。
因此现实性把另一个方面、把对知来说陌生的那个方面隐藏在自己内部，并且不向意识显示它自在自为的样子，——不向儿子显示他打死的那个侮辱者身上的父亲，——也不显示他娶为妻子的那位王后身上的母亲。
对伦理的自我意识来说，一种躲避光亮的势力就这样在暗中追逼着它，这种势力只有当行为已经发生时，才爆发出来并在行为上抓住它；因为完成了的行为就是知着的自我与在它对面立着的现实性之间那个被扬弃了的对立。
行动着的人不能否认罪行和他的罪过；行为就是这个：把不动的推动起来，把还仅仅封闭在可能性中的东西产生出来，并由此把无意识的东西与有意识的东西、把不存在的东西与存在联结起来。
所以行为就在这真理中走到阳光下，——作为一种东西，其中有意识的东西与无意识的东西、自己的东西与陌生的东西联结在一起，作为分裂了的本质，意识经验到它的另一面，并且也经验为它自己的另一面，但却是作为被它伤害了的、被敌对地激起的势力。

en: It may be that the right which kept itself in ambush is present for acting consciousness not in its own proper shape, but only in itself, in the inner guilt of the resolution and of the acting.

But ethical consciousness is more complete, its guilt purer, when it knows beforehand the law and the power it steps up against, takes them for violence and wrong, for an ethical contingency, and knowingly, like Antigone, commits the crime.
The accomplished deed reverses its view; the accomplishment itself declares that what is ethical must be actual; for the actuality of the purpose is the purpose of acting.

Acting declares precisely the unity of actuality and substance; it declares that actuality is not contingent for the essence, but that, in league with it, nothing is given to anyone that is not true right.
Ethical consciousness must, for the sake of this actuality and for the sake of its doing, acknowledge its opposite as its own, it must acknowledge its guilt;
zh: 有可能，那个埋伏着的权利对行动着的意识来说并不是以它特有的形态存在的，而只是自在的，存在于决断和行动的内在罪过之中。
但伦理意识更完整，它的罪过更纯粹，如果它事先认识它所面对的那种法则和势力，把它们当作暴力和不义，当作一种伦理上的偶然性，并且像安提戈涅那样明知地犯下罪行。
完成了的行为颠倒了它的看法；完成本身说出了这一点：伦理的东西必须是现实的；因为目的的现实性就是行动的目的。
行动恰好说出了现实性和实体的统一，它说出：现实性对本质来说不是偶然的，相反，与本质结盟，任何不是真的权利的东西都不会被给予任何人。
伦理意识必须由于这种现实性、由于它的作为，把它的对立面承认为它自己的对立面，它必须承认自己的罪过；

en: because we suffer, we recognize that we have done wrong.
zh: 因为我们受苦，我们才承认，我们犯了错。

en: This recognition expresses the sublated discord of the ethical purpose and of actuality, it expresses the return to the ethical disposition that knows that nothing counts but what is right.
But with this the agent gives up its character and the actuality of its self, and has perished.

Its being is this, to belong to its ethical law as its substance; but in the recognition of the opposite, this has ceased to be substance for it; and instead of its actuality it has attained unreality, the disposition.

– The substance indeed appears on individuality as its pathos, and individuality as what animates it and therefore stands above it; but it is a pathos that is at the same time its character; ethical individuality is immediately and in itself one with this its universal, it has its existence only in it and cannot survive the downfall that this ethical power suffers through the opposed one.
zh: 这种承认表达出伦理目的和现实性之间已被扬弃的分裂，它表达出向伦理意向的回归，这种意向知道，除了正当的东西，什么也不算数。
但这样一来，行动者就放弃了自己的性格和自己这个自我的现实性，并且已经毁灭了。
它的存在就是这一点，即属于作为它实体的伦理法则；但在承认对立面时，这法则却已不再对它来说是实体；而它代替自己的现实性所达到的，是非现实性，即意向。
——实体虽然显现在个体性上，作为个体性的激情，而个体性则显现为赋予实体以生命、因而立于实体之上的东西；但实体是一种激情，它同时就是个体性的性格；伦理的个体性直接地、自在地与它的这个普遍东西是同一的，它只有在其中才有自己的存在，并且不能挺过这种伦理势力通过对立的那种势力所遭受的毁灭。

en: But in this it has the certainty that the individuality whose pathos this opposed power is suffers no more evil than it has inflicted.

The movement of the ethical powers against one another, and of the individualities that set them into life and action, has reached its true end only in this, that both sides undergo the same downfall.
For neither of the powers has anything in advance of the other, so as to be the more essential moment of the substance.

The equal essentiality and the indifferent subsistence of both alongside one another is their selfless being; in fact they are as self-essences, but a different one, which contradicts the unity of the self and constitutes their lawlessness and necessary downfall.

The character likewise belongs partly, according to its pathos or substance, only to the one; partly, on the side of knowing, the one as well as the other is divided into a conscious and an unconscious; and since each itself calls forth this opposition and through the deed the not-knowing too is its work, it puts itself into the guilt that consumes it.
The victory of the one power and of its character and the defeat of the other side would therefore be only the part and the unfinished work that advances unstoppably toward the equilibrium of both.
Only in the equal subjugation of both sides is absolute right accomplished and has the ethical substance stepped forth as the negative power that devours both sides, or as the almighty and just fate.
zh: 但它在其中具有确定性，即那种以这对立势力为其激情的个体性，所遭受的灾祸不会多于它所加予的。
伦理势力相互之间的运动，以及把这些势力投入生命和行动的那些个体性的运动，只有在这一点上才达到其真正的终点，即双方遭受同样的毁灭。
因为两种势力中没有任何一种比另一种占先，从而能成为实体更本质的环节。
双方同等的本质性和彼此漠不相关地并列持存，就是它们的无自我状态；实际上，它们是作为自我本质而存在的，但却是一种不同的自我本质，这与自我的统一相矛盾，并构成它们的无法权状态和必然的毁灭。
性格同样一方面按其激情或实体只属于那一方，另一方面从知识这一面来看，这一方和另一方都分裂为一个有意识的东西和一个无意识的东西；而由于每一方自己都引起这种对立，并且通过行动，不知情也成了它的作品，所以它就把自己置于那吞噬它的罪过之中。
所以，一方势力及其性格的胜利和另一方的失败，就只会是那个部分和未完成的作品，它不可阻挡地走向双方的平衡。
只有在双方同等的屈服中，绝对的法权才得以完成，伦理实体才作为吞没双方的否定势力，或者作为全能而公正的命运而出现。

en: If both powers are taken according to their determinate content and its individualization, there presents itself the picture of their configured conflict: according to its formal side, as the conflict of ethical life and of self-consciousness with unconscious nature and with a contingency that exists through it (this contingency has a right against the former, because the latter is only the true spirit, only in immediate unity with its substance), and according to its content, as the discord of the divine and the human law.

– The youth steps out of the unconscious essence, out of the family spirit, and becomes the individuality of the commonwealth; but that he still belongs to the nature from which he tore himself away proves itself in this, that he comes forth in the contingency of two brothers, who seize the same thing with equal right; the inequality of earlier and later birth has, for them who enter into the ethical essence, no significance as a difference of nature.

But the government, as the simple soul or the self of the spirit of the people, does not tolerate a duality of individuality; and over against the ethical necessity of this unity, nature steps forth as the contingency of plurality.
These two therefore fall into discord, and their equal right to state power shatters both, who have equal wrong.

Considered in human terms, the crime has been committed by the one who, not in possession, attacks the commonwealth at whose head the other stood; the one, by contrast, has right on his side who knew how to grasp the other only as a single individual, detached from the commonwealth, and drove him out in this powerlessness; he has touched only the individual as such, not that commonwealth, not the essence of human right.

The commonwealth attacked and defended by empty singleness preserves itself, and the brothers both find their mutual downfall through one another; for the individuality that ties the danger of the whole to its being-for-itself has itself expelled itself from the commonwealth and dissolves in itself.

But the one who found himself on its side it will honor; the other, however, who already on the walls proclaimed his devastation, the government, the restored simplicity of the self of the commonwealth, will punish with the last honor; whoever came to lay hands on the highest spirit of consciousness, the community, must be deprived of the honor of his whole completed essence, the honor of the departed spirit.
zh: 如果两种势力按其特定的内容及其个体化来看，那么它们那被塑成形态的冲突就呈现出这样一幅图像：从形式方面看，它是伦理与自我意识同无意识自然、以及同一种通过自然而存在的偶然性之间的冲突（这种偶然性对前者有一种法权，因为前者只是真正的精神，只处于与其实体的直接统一之中），而从内容方面看，它是神的法则与人的法则之间的分裂。
——少年走出无意识的本质，走出家庭精神，成为共同体的个体性；但他仍然属于自己从中挣脱出来的自然，这一点是这样表明的：他出现在两兄弟的偶然性中，这两兄弟以同等的法权占有同一个东西；出生先后的不等，对于进入伦理本质的他们来说，作为自然的差别没有任何意义。
但政府作为单纯的灵魂或民族精神的自我，不能容忍个体性的二重性；而与这种统一的伦理必然性相对，自然则作为多数的偶然性而出现。
因此这两者陷入不和，他们对国家权力的同等法权砸碎了双方，而双方有着同等的不义。
从人的方面来看，犯下罪行的是那个在并不占有的情况下攻击那个以另一人为首脑的共同体的人；反之，有法权在自己一边的，是那个懂得把另一人只当作单个的个人、当作脱离了共同体的人来把握、并在他这种无力中把他赶走的人；他所触犯的只是作为这样的个体，而不是那个共同体，不是人的法权的本质。
被空洞的单一性所攻击和保卫的共同体保存了下来，而两兄弟则通过彼此各自遭遇到相互的毁灭；因为那种把自己的自为存在与整体的危险联结起来的个体性，已经把自己从共同体中排除出去，并在自身内消解了。
但那个站在它这一边的人，它会加以尊敬；而另一个已在城墙上宣告其破坏的人，政府——共同体自我的恢复了单纯性——则要用最后的荣誉来惩罚他；谁若竟然侵犯了意识的最高精神，即共同体，他就必须被剥夺其整个完成了的本质的荣誉，即已逝精神的荣誉。

en: But if the universal thus lightly thrusts off the pure apex of its pyramid and indeed carries off the victory over the rebelling principle of singularity, the family, it has thereby engaged with the divine law only in struggle — the spirit conscious of itself with the unconscious one; for this is the other essential power that is therefore undestroyed by the former and only offended.
But against the ruling law that lies in the day, it has its help for actual execution only in the bloodless shadow.
As the law of weakness and of darkness, it therefore first succumbs to the law of the day and of force, for that power holds below, not on earth.
But the actual, which has taken from the inner its honor and power, has thereby consumed its essence.

The manifest spirit has the root of its force in the underworld; the self-assured and self-assuring certainty of the people has the truth of its oath binding all into one only in the unconscious and mute substance of all, in the waters of forgetfulness.
Thereby the accomplishment of the manifest spirit turns into the opposite, and it experiences that its highest right is the highest wrong, its victory rather its own downfall.
The dead man whose right is violated therefore knows how to find tools for his revenge that are of the same actuality and violence as the power that injured him.

These powers are other commonwealths, whose altars the dogs or birds defiled with the corpse, which was not raised into the unconscious universality through the return owed to it to the elemental individual, but has remained above the earth in the realm of actuality and now, as the force of the divine law, receives a self-conscious actual universality.
They set themselves hostilely on the march and destroy the commonwealth that has dishonored and broken its force, the piety of the family.
zh: 但是，如果普遍东西这样轻易地把自己金字塔的纯粹尖端推开，并且虽然战胜了那个起来反抗的单一性原则即家庭，那么它由此就与神的法则、自身意识着的精神就与无意识的精神，只是陷入了斗争；因为后者是另一种本质性的势力，因而并未被前者摧毁，只是受到了冒犯。
但它对于那种掌权的、处于白昼之中的法则，要使自己的帮助真正得到实行，却只有靠那无血的阴影。
作为软弱和黑暗的法则，它因此首先屈服于白昼和力的法则，因为那种势力只在下面有效，不在地上。
但是，那个夺去了内在东西的荣誉和势力的现实东西，由此也就耗尽了自己的本质。
公开的精神其力的根源在下界；民族那种自信并自我确证的确定性，其把一切联结为一的誓言的真理，只在于一切人那无意识的、沉默的实体中，在于遗忘之水之中。
由此，公开的精神的完成就转变为反面，而它经验到，它的最高法权就是最高的不法，它的胜利毋宁是它自己的毁灭。
死者，其法权受到侵害，因此懂得为他的复仇找到一些工具，这些工具与伤害他的那种势力具有相同的现实性和暴力。
这些势力是别的共同体，狗或鸟曾用尸体玷污了它们的祭坛，而这尸体并没有通过那应归于它的、归还给元素性个体的方式被提升到无意识的普遍性中，而是留在大地之上、留在现实性的王国里，并且现在作为神的法则的力而获得一种自身意识着的、现实的普遍性。
它们敌对地行动起来，摧毁那个共同体，因为它已经羞辱并折断了自己的力，即家庭的虔敬。

en: In this representation, the movement of the human and the divine law has the expression of its necessity in individuals, on whom the universal appears as a pathos and the activity of the movement as individual doing, which gives to the necessity of that movement the semblance of contingency.
But individuality and the doing constitute the principle of singularity in general, which in its pure universality was called the inner divine law.

As a moment of the manifest commonwealth, it has not only that subterranean, or in its determinate being external, efficacy, but an equally manifest, actual determinate being and movement on the actual people.

Taken in this form, what was represented as the simple movement of individualized pathos receives a different look, and the crime and the destruction of the commonwealth grounded thereby receive the proper form of their determinate being.

– The human law, then – in its universal determinate being the commonwealth, in its activity in general masculinity, in its actual activity the government – is, moves and maintains itself by devouring within itself the separation of the Penates, or the independent individualization into families over which womanhood presides, and by keeping them dissolved in the continuity of its fluidity.
But the family is at the same time its element in general, the single consciousness the universal activating ground.

In that the commonwealth gives itself its subsistence only through the disturbance of family happiness and the dissolution of self-consciousness into the universal, it produces for itself its inner enemy in what it suppresses and what is at the same time essential to it, in womanhood in general.

This one – the eternal irony of the commonwealth – changes, through intrigue, the universal purpose of the government into a private purpose, transforms its universal activity into a work of this determinate individual, and turns the universal property of the state into a possession and ornament of the family.

Thereby she makes the serious wisdom of ripe age, which, dead to singularity – to pleasure and enjoyment as well as to actual activity – thinks and cares only for the universal, into a mockery for the wantonness of immature youth and into contempt for its enthusiasm, and raises in general the power of youth to what counts: of the son, in whom the mother has born her lord, of the brother, in whom the sister has the man as her equal, of the youth, through whom the daughter, taken out of her dependence, attains the enjoyment and the dignity of womanhood.

– But the commonwealth can maintain itself only through the suppression of this spirit of singularity, and, because it is an essential moment, it indeed produces it likewise, namely through the suppressing attitude towards it, as a hostile principle.

This principle, however, since in separating itself from the universal purpose it is only evil and null in itself, would be capable of nothing if the commonwealth itself did not recognize the power of youth, masculinity, which, not yet ripe, still stands within singularity, as the power of the whole.

For it is a people, it is itself individuality, and essentially is for itself only in such a way that other individualities are for it, that it excludes them from itself and knows itself independent of them.
The negative side of the commonwealth, inwardly suppressing the individualization of individuals, but outwardly itself active, has its weapons in individuality.

War is the spirit and the form in which the essential moment of the ethical substance, the absolute freedom of the ethical self-essence from all determinate being, is present in its actuality and attestation.

While on the one hand it lets the individual systems of property and of personal independence, as also the individual personality itself, feel the power of the negative, on the other hand in it precisely this negative essence raises itself as the preserving element of the whole; the brave youth, in whom womanhood has its pleasure, the suppressed principle of ruin, steps into the day and is what counts.

Now it is natural force and what appears as the contingency of fortune that decide over the determinate being of the ethical essence and over spiritual necessity; because the determinate being of the ethical essence rests on strength and fortune, it is already decided that it has gone to ruin.

– Just as previously only the Penates within the spirit of the people, so now the living spirits of peoples go to ruin through their individuality in a universal commonwealth whose simple universality is spiritless and dead and whose liveliness is the single individual, as singular.
The ethical shape of spirit has disappeared, and another steps into its place.
zh: 在这种表象中，人的法则和神的法则的运动，其必然性的表达落在个体身上，在这些个体身上，普遍的东西显现为一种激情，而运动的能动性显现为个体的行动，这种行动赋予这运动本身的必然性以偶然性的假象。
但个体性和行动构成单一性一般的原则，这原则在其纯粹的普遍性中曾被称为内在的神的法则。
作为公开的共同体的一个环节，它不只有那种地下的、或者在其定在中外在的效力，而且还有一种同样公开的、在现实的民族身上现实的定在和运动。
取这种形式来看，那曾被表象为个体化激情的单纯运动的东西就获得了另一种样子，而罪行以及由此造成的共同体的毁灭也获得了它们定在的真正形式。
——所以，人的法则在其普遍的定在中就是共同体，在其一般的活动中就是男性，在其现实的活动中就是政府，它通过把家神的分离、或者那些由女性主导的家庭中独立的单一化在自己内部吞噬掉，并使它们在它流动性的连续性中保持溶解状态，而存在、运动和维持自身。
但家庭同时一般地就是它的要素，而单个的意识则是普遍地活动着的根据。
共同体只有通过扰乱家庭的幸福、把自我意识消解到普遍的东西之中，才给自己取得持存，所以它在自己所压制、同时又对它是本质性的东西那里，即在女性一般那里，为自己产生出内在的敌人。
这种女性——共同体的永恒反讽——通过阴谋把政府的普遍目的改变为私人目的，把它的普遍活动转变为这个特定个体的作品，并把国家的普遍财产颠倒为家庭的占有物和装饰。
她由此把成熟年龄的严肃智慧——这种智慧对单一性，即对快乐和享受以及现实的活动，已经死去，只思想并操心普遍的东西——变成不成熟青年任性的笑料，变成对青年热情的鄙视，并且一般地把青年的力提升为有效的东西，即儿子、兄弟和少年的力：母亲在儿子身上生出了自己的主人，姐妹在兄弟身上把男人当作与自己同等的人，女儿则通过少年摆脱了自己的非独立性，获得了妇人身份的享受和尊严。
——但共同体只有通过压制这种单一性的精神才能维持自身，而正因为它是一个本质性的环节，共同体虽然也同样产生它，不过是通过对它的压制态度，把它产生为一个敌对的原则。
不过，这个原则既然脱离普遍目的，就只是恶的、在自身中空无的，所以，如果共同体自己不把青年的力——即那个尚未成熟、还站在单一性之内的男性——承认为整体的力，那它就什么也做不成。
因为它是一个民族，它本身就是个体性，并且本质上只有这样才是自为的：其他个体性对它是存在的，它把它们从自己那里排除出去，并知道自己不依赖于它们。
共同体的这个否定方面，对内压制个体的单一化，对外则自行活动，它在个体性那里拥有自己的武器。
战争就是这样一种精神和形式：伦理实体的本质性环节，即伦理的自我本质对一切定在的绝对自由，在其中以其现实性和验证而存在。
战争一方面让财产和个人独立性的各个体系、以及单个的人格本身感觉到否定的力，另一方面，正是在战争中，这个否定的本质把自己提升为整体的保存者；那个勇敢的少年，女性在他身上拥有自己的快乐，那个被压制的毁灭原则，由此显露出来，并且是有效的东西。
现在，是自然的力和那显现为幸运之偶然性的东西在决定伦理本质的定在和精神的必然性；因为伦理本质的定在建立在力量和幸运之上，所以已经决定了：它已经毁灭了。
——正如先前在民族精神中只有家神，现在，活生生的诸民族精神也通过它们的个体性在一个普遍的共同体中走向毁灭，这个共同体的单纯普遍性是无精神的、死的，而它的活生生则是单个的个体，作为单一者。
精神的伦理形态已经消失，另一个形态取代了它的位置。

en: This downfall of the ethical substance and its transition into another shape is thus determined by the fact that ethical consciousness is essentially directed immediately upon the law; in this determination of immediacy lies the fact that nature in general enters into the action of ethical life.

Its actuality reveals only the contradiction, and the germ of ruin that the beautiful concord and the calm equilibrium of the ethical spirit has precisely in this calm and beauty itself; for immediacy has the contradictory meaning of being the unconscious calm of nature and the self-conscious, unquiet calm of spirit.
– For the sake of this naturalness, this ethical people is in general an individuality determined by nature and therefore limited, and thus finds its sublation in another.

But in that this determinacy, which, posited in determinate being, is limitation, but likewise the negative in general and the self of individuality, disappears, the life of spirit and this substance, conscious of itself in all, are lost.
It steps forth on them as a formal universality, no longer dwells in them as living spirit, but the simple solidity of their individuality has burst asunder into many points.
zh: 所以，伦理实体的这种没落以及它向另一个形态的过渡是这样规定的：伦理意识本质上直接地指向法则；在这种直接性的规定中包含着：自然一般进入了伦理的行动。
它的现实性只暴露出矛盾，以及伦理精神那种美好的同心一致和宁静的平衡恰恰在这种宁静和美好本身中带有的毁灭的萌芽；因为直接性具有这样一个矛盾的含义：既是自然无意识的宁静，又是精神那自我意识的、不安宁的宁静。
——由于这种自然性，这个伦理的民族一般就是一种由自然规定、因而受限制的个体性，所以它在一个他者那里找到自己的扬弃。
但是，当这种规定性——它在定在中被设定起来，就是限制，但同样是一般的否定的东西和个体性的自我——消失时，精神的生命和这一在一切之中意识到自身的实体也就丧失了。
它作为一种形式的普遍性在他们身上显露出来，不再作为活生生的精神内居于他们之中，而是他们的个体性那单纯的坚实性已经碎裂成许多点。

en: The universal unity into which the living immediate unity of individuality and substance withdraws is the spiritless commonwealth, which has ceased to be the itself unconscious substance of the individuals, and in which they now count, according to their single being-for-itself, as self-essences and substances.
The universal, shattered into the atoms of the absolutely many individuals, this dead spirit, is an equality in which all count as each, as persons.

What in the world of ethical life was called the hidden divine law has in fact stepped out of its inner being into actuality; in that world the single individual really counted and was only as the universal blood of the family.
As this single individual he was the selfless, departed spirit; but now he has stepped forth out of his unreality.

Because the ethical substance is only the true spirit, it therefore withdraws into the certainty of itself; as the positive universal it is that substance, but its actuality is to be the negative universal self.
– We saw the powers and the shapes of the ethical world sink into the simple necessity of empty fate.

This power of theirs is the substance reflecting itself into its simplicity; but the absolute essence reflecting itself in itself, precisely that necessity of empty fate, is nothing other than the I of self-consciousness.
zh: 个体性和实体的那种活生生的直接统一退回于其中的普遍统一，就是无精神的共同体，它已经不再是诸个体那自身无意识的实体，而在其中，诸个体现在按照它们单个的自为存在，作为自我本质和实体而有效。
这个普遍的东西，碎裂为绝对众多的个体的原子，这个已经死去的精神，是一种平等，在其中所有人都作为每一个、作为人格而有效。
在伦理的世界中曾被称为隐秘的神的法则的东西，事实上已经从它的内在之中走进了现实性；在那个世界里，单个的个人现实地只作为家庭的普遍血缘而有效、而存在。
作为这个单个的个人，他曾是那无自我的、已经离去的精神；但现在，他已经从自己的非现实性中走了出来。
因为伦理实体只是真的精神，所以它退回于它自身的确定性之中；作为肯定的普遍东西，它就是那实体，但它的现实性却在于，它是那否定的普遍自我。
——我们曾看到伦理世界的诸势力和诸形态沉没在空洞命运的单纯必然性之中。
它们这种势力就是那反思到自己的单纯性之中的实体；但那在自身中反思着的绝对本质，即空洞命运的那种必然性，不外是自我意识的「我」。

en: This therefore now counts as the essence that is in and for itself; this being-recognized is its substantiality; but it is abstract universality, because its content is this brittle self, not the self dissolved in the substance.
zh: 它由此现在就被当作自在自为地存在着的本质；这种被承认就是它的实体性；但这种实体性是抽象的普遍性，因为它的内容是这个僵硬的自我的，而不是在实体中消解了的自我的。

en: Personality has therefore here stepped out of the life of the ethical substance; it is the really valid independence of consciousness.

The unreal thought of it, which arises through the renunciation of actuality, has earlier come up as stoic self-consciousness; just as this [came up] out of mastery and servitude as the immediate determinate being of self-consciousness, so personality has emerged out of the immediate spirit that is the universal ruling will of all and likewise their serving obedience.
What for Stoicism was the in-itself only in abstraction is now actual world.

It [Stoicism] is nothing other than the consciousness that brings the principle of the legal condition, spiritless independence, onto its abstract form; through its flight out of actuality it attained only the thought of independence; it is absolutely for itself in that it does not tie its essence to any determinate being, but [wills] to give up every determinate being and places its essence solely in the unity of pure thinking.

In the same way the right of the person is tied neither to a richer or more powerful determinate being of the individual as such, nor to a universal living spirit, but rather to the pure one of its abstract actuality or to it as self-consciousness in general.
zh: 人格于是在这里已经走出了伦理实体的生命；人格是意识的真正有效的独立性。
人格的那个非现实的思想，即通过放弃现实性而产生的思想，先前已经作为斯多葛式的自我意识出现过；正如这种自我意识是从主人与奴隶、即从自我意识的直接定在中产生出来的，人格也是从直接的精神中产生出来的，而这种精神就是所有人普遍的统治意志，同样也是他们服侍的服从。
对斯多葛主义来说仅仅是抽象地自在的东西，现在成了现实的世界。
它不外是那种把法权状态的原则、即无精神的独立性，带到自己的抽象形式上的意识；通过它从现实性中的逃遁，它只达到了独立性的思想；它之所以绝对地自为，是因为它不把自己的本质系于任何一种定在，而是要放弃每一种定在，并把自己的本质仅仅设定在纯粹思维的统一之中。
同样，人格的法权既不是系于个体作为个体的更丰富或更有力的定在，也不是系于一种普遍的、活生生的精神，而是系于它那抽象现实性的纯粹的一，或者系于它作为一般自我意识。

en: Now just as the abstract independence of Stoicism presented its realization, so this latter too will repeat the movement of that first one.

That first one passes over into the sceptical confusion of consciousness, into a drivelling of the negative, which, formless, wanders from one contingency of being and thought to the other, indeed dissolves them in absolute independence, but just as much brings them forth again, and in fact is only the contradiction of the independence and dependence of consciousness.
– Likewise the personal independence of right is rather this same universal confusion and mutual dissolution.
For what counts as the absolute essence is self-consciousness as the pure empty one of the person.

Over against this empty universality the substance has the form of fulfilment and of content, and this is now wholly set free and unordered; for the spirit is no longer present that subjugated it and held it together in its unity.
– This empty one of the person is therefore in its reality a contingent determinate being and essence-less motion and doing, which comes to no subsistence.

Like scepticism, the formalism of right is therefore through its concept without a peculiar content, finds a manifold subsistence, possession, before it and impresses on it the same abstract universality, whereby it is called property, as that first one does.
But if the actuality thus determined is called semblance in general in scepticism and has only a negative value, then in right it has a positive one.

That negative value consists in this, that the actual has the meaning of the self as thinking, as the in-itself universal, this positive one, however, in this, that it is Mine in the meaning of the category, as a recognized and actual validity.

– Both are the same abstract universal, the actual content or the determinacy of the Mine – whether of an external possession or also of the inner wealth or poverty of spirit and character – is not contained in this empty form and does not concern it.
It therefore belongs to a power of its own that is an other than the formal-universal, which is contingency and arbitrariness.

The consciousness of right therefore in its actual validity experiences rather the loss of its reality and its complete essence-lessness, and to designate an individual as a person is an expression of contempt.
zh: 现在，正如斯多葛主义的抽象独立性展示了它的实现，这后一种实现也会重复那第一种实现的运动。
那第一种实现过渡为意识的怀疑论式的混乱，过渡为一种关于否定东西的胡言乱语，它无形无状地从存在和思维的一种偶然性游荡到另一种偶然性，固然把它们消解在绝对的独立性之中，但同样又把它们重新产生出来，并且实际上只是意识的独立性与非独立性的矛盾。
——同样，法权的个人独立性毋宁就是这同一种普遍的混乱和相互消解。
因为被当作绝对本质的东西，就是作为人格的纯粹空洞的一的自我意识。
针对这种空洞的普遍性，实体具有充实和内容的形式，而这种内容现在被完全放开了、毫无秩序；因为那个曾经把它征服、把它保持在自己的统一之中的精神已经不再存在。
——因此，人格的这个空洞的一在它的实在性中是一种偶然的定在和无本质的运动与行动，它达不到任何持存。
所以，和怀疑论一样，法权形式主义通过它的概念就没有特有的内容，它在自己面前发现一种杂多的持存，即占有，并且像怀疑论一样，把同一种抽象的普遍性、即它由此被称为财产的那种普遍性，印在占有之上。
但是，如果这样被规定的现实性在怀疑论中一般被称为假象，并且只有一种否定的价值，那么它在法权中就有一种肯定的价值。
那种否定的价值在于：现实的东西具有自我作为思维、作为自在普遍的东西的意义；而这种肯定的价值则在于：它是我的东西，具有范畴的意义，是一种被承认的、现实的有效性。
——两者都是同一种抽象的普遍东西；现实的内容或者我的东西的规定性——无论是一种外在的占有，还是精神与性格的内在富有或贫乏——并不包含在这种空洞的形式之中，也与它无关。
因此，它属于一种自己的势力，这种势力是不同于形式上的普遍东西的另一种东西，即偶然性和任意。
所以，法权的意识在它现实的有效性中毋宁经验到它的实在性的丧失和它完全的无关紧要，而把一个个体称为人格，就是轻蔑的表达。

en: The free power of the content determines itself in such a way that the dispersal into the absolute plurality of personal atoms is at the same time, through the nature of this determinacy, gathered into a point foreign to them and equally spiritless, which on the one hand, like the brittleness of their personality, is purely single actuality, but in opposition to their empty singularity is at the same time of the significance of all content, and thereby of the real essence for them, and over against their supposed absolute, but in itself essence-less actuality is the universal power and absolute actuality.
This lord of the world is in this way for himself the absolute person who at the same time comprehends all determinate being within himself, for whose consciousness no higher spirit exists.

He is person, but the lonely person who has stepped over against all; these all make up the valid universality of the person, for the single as such is true only as the universal plurality of singularity; separated from this, the lonely self is in fact the unreal, powerless self.
– At the same time it is the consciousness of the content that has stepped over against that universal personality.

This content, however, freed from its negative power, is the chaos of the spiritual powers, which, unfettered as elementary essences, move in wild excess against one another, mad and destroying; their powerless self-consciousness is the power-less enclosure and the ground of their tumult.

Knowing itself thus as the epitome of all actual powers, this lord of the world is the monstrous self-consciousness that knows itself as the actual God; but since he is only the formal self that is unable to bridle them, his movement and self-enjoyment is the equally monstrous excess.
zh: 内容的自由势力这样规定自己：向人格原子的绝对杂多之中的分散，由于这种规定性的本性，同时又被聚集到一个对它们陌生的、同样无精神的点之中，这个点一方面像它们人格的僵硬性一样是纯粹单一的现实性，但另一方面在与它们空洞的个别性对立时，同时具有一切内容的意义、从而对它们来说具有实在本质的意义，并且针对它们臆想中绝对的、但自在却无本质的现实性，它是普遍的势力和绝对的现实性。
这个世间主人以这种方式就是自为的、同时把一切定在都包含在自身之内的绝对人格，对于它的意识来说，不存在更高的精神。
他是人格，但是已经与一切相对而立的孤独的人格；所有这些人格构成了人格的有效普遍性，因为个别的东西作为个别的东西，只有作为个别性的普遍杂多才成其为真的；与这种普遍性分离开来，孤独的自我实际上就是非现实的、无力的自我。
——同时，它是对那种普遍人格相对而立的那个内容的意识。
然而，这种内容从其否定的势力中解放出来，就是各种精神势力的混沌，这些势力作为元素式的本质被解除了束缚，在狂野的放荡中疯狂而毁灭性地相互运动；它们无力的自我意识是这种混乱的无力的环绕和基地。
这样把自己知为一切现实势力的总括，这个世间主人就是那巨大的自我意识，它把自己知为现实的上帝；但是，正因为它只是那不能驯服这些势力的形式性的自我，所以它的运动和自身享受就是同样巨大的放荡。

en: The lord of the world has the actual consciousness of what he is, of the universal power of actuality, in the destroying violence that he exercises against the self of his subjects that stands over against him.

For his power is not the unity of spirit, in which the persons would cognize their own self-consciousness; rather, as persons they are for themselves and exclude the continuity with others out of the absolute brittleness of their punctuality; they are therefore in a merely negative relation both to one another and to him who is their relation or continuity.

As this continuity he is the essence and the content of their formalism, but the content foreign to them and the hostile essence that rather sublates precisely that which counts for them as their essence, the content-less being-for-itself – and as the continuity of their personality destroys precisely this.

The legal personality therefore, in that the content foreign to it makes itself valid in it – and it makes itself valid in them because it is their reality –, experiences rather its substance-lessness.

The destroying rummaging in this essence-less ground, by contrast, gives the consciousness of its all-lordship, but this self is mere devastation, hence only outside itself and rather the throwing away of its self-consciousness.
zh: 世间主人对他是什么、对现实性的普遍势力，拥有现实的意识，而这意识就在他针对那些与他相对而立的臣民的自我所施加的毁灭性暴力之中。
因为他的势力并不是精神的统一性，在那种统一性中，各个人格会认识到自己的自我意识；相反，它们作为人格是自为的，并且由于它们点状存在的绝对僵硬性而把与别人的连续性排除在外；所以，它们既相互之间、又对那个作为它们的关系或连续性的他，都处于仅仅否定的关系之中。
作为这种连续性，他是它们形式主义的东西的本质和内容，但却是对它们陌生的内容和敌对的本质，这个本质毋宁恰好扬弃了那对它们来说被当作它们本质的东西，即无内容的自为存在——并且作为它们人格的连续性，恰恰毁灭了这种人格。
所以，法权人格在那种对它陌生的内容于它之中生效时——而它之所以在它们之中生效，是因为它是它们的实在性——，毋宁经验到自己的无实体性。
相反，在这种无本质的基地上的毁灭性翻掘，则给予意识它全能统治的意识，但这个自我只是纯粹的毁坏，因此只是在自己之外，毋宁说是抛弃了它的自我意识。

en: Such is the constitution of the side on which self-consciousness is actual as absolute essence.

But consciousness, driven back into itself out of this actuality, thinks this its own non-essence; we saw earlier the stoical self-sufficiency of pure thinking pass through scepticism and find its truth in the unhappy consciousness – the truth of what is the case with its being-in-and-for-itself.
If this knowing then appeared only as the one-sided view of consciousness as such, its actual truth has here come on the scene.
It consists in this, that this universal validity of self-consciousness is the reality estranged from it.
This validity is the universal actuality of the self, but it is immediately just as much the inversion; it is the loss of its essence.

– The actuality of the self, which was not present in the ethical world, has been won through its retreat into the person; what in that world was one now comes forth developed, but estranged from itself.
zh: 自我意识在其中作为绝对本质是现实的那一面，就是这样一种情形。
但意识被从这种现实性中赶回到自身之内，它思考的正是它自己的这种非本质；我们前面已经看到，纯粹思维的斯多葛式独立性穿过了怀疑论，并且在苦恼意识中找到了它的真理——即它的自在自为存在究竟处于何种情形的真理。
如果说这种知识当时只表现为意识作为意识的一种片面看法，那么它的现实的真理在这里已经出现了。
它在于：自我意识的这种普遍有效就是那对它已经异化了的实在性。
这种有效是自我的普遍现实性，但它直接地同样是颠倒；它是它自己本质的丧失。
——自我在伦理世界中并不存在的现实性，是通过退回人格之中而赢得的；在那里曾经是统一的东西，现在则以发展了的、但自身异化了的样子出现。

23.en: B. Spirit estranged from itself. Culture
23.zh: B. 自身异化了的精神。教养

en: The ethical substance kept the opposition enclosed within its simple consciousness, and this consciousness in immediate unity with its essence.

The essence therefore has, for consciousness, the simple determinacy of being, to which consciousness is immediately directed and whose custom it is; consciousness no more counts for itself as this excluding self, than the substance has the meaning of a determinate being excluded from it, with which it would have to posit itself as one only through the estrangement of itself and at the same time to bring that estrangement forth.

But that spirit whose self is the absolutely discrete has its content over against itself as an equally hard actuality, and the world here has the determination of being something external, the negative of self-consciousness.

But this world is spiritual essence, it is in itself the interpenetration of being and individuality; this its determinate being is the work of self-consciousness; but equally an immediately present actuality, foreign to it, which has a being of its own and in which it does not recognize itself.

It is the external essence and the free content of right; but this external actuality, which the lord of the world of right comprehends in himself, is not merely this elemental essence that chance makes present for the self, but is its own work – not positive, however, but negative.

It receives its determinate being through the self-consciousness's own externalization and loss of essence, which in the devastation ruling in the world of right seems to inflict on it the external violence of the unleashed elements.

These, for themselves, are only pure devastation and the dissolution of themselves; but this dissolution, this negative essence of theirs, is precisely the self; it is their subject, their doing and becoming.

This doing and becoming, however, whereby the substance becomes actual, is the estrangement of personality, for the self that immediately, that is, without estrangement, counts as being in and for itself, is without substance and is the play of those raging elements; its substance is therefore its own externalization, and the externalization is the substance, or the spiritual powers that order themselves into a world and thereby preserve themselves.
zh: 伦理实体把对立保持在它的简单意识之内，并把这个意识保持在它与它的本质的直接统一之中。
因此，本质对意识而言具有存在的简单规定性，意识直接朝向它，而它就是意识的习俗；意识既不自认为这个排他的自我，实体也不具有这样一种含义，即它是一种被排除在意识之外的定在，意识只有通过自身异化才能把自己与它设定为一，并同时把这种异化产生出来。
但是，那种其自我是绝对离散的精神，却让自己的内容作为同样坚硬的现实性与自己相对而立，而世界在这里的规定则是：成为一个外在的东西，成为自我意识的否定物。
但这个世界是精神性的本质，它自在地是存在与个体性的相互渗透；它的这个定在是自我意识的作品，但同样是一种直接现成的、对它异己的现实性，这种现实性有自己特有的存在，而自我意识在其中并不认识自己。
它是法权的外在本质和自由内容；但法权世界的主人在自身内所包含的这种外在的现实性，并不只是这种偶然地为自我而现成的元素性本质，而是它自己的劳动，只不过不是肯定的劳动，而是否定的劳动。
它通过自我意识自身的外化和丧失本质而获得自己的定在，而这种外化和丧失本质，在法权世界中盛行的荒芜里，似乎把那些被解除束缚的元素的外在暴力加在它身上。
这些元素自为地只是纯粹的荒芜和它们自身的解体；但这种解体，这种它们自己的否定性的本质，恰恰就是自我；它是它们的主体，是它们的行动和生成。
但是，实体借以成为现实的这种行动和生成，就是人格性的异化；因为那直接地、也就是说无需异化就自在自为地有效的自我，是没有实体的，是那些狂乱元素的玩物；所以它的实体就是它自己的外化，而外化就是实体，或者说就是那些把自己安排成一个世界、并因此保存自己的精神力量。

en: In this way the substance is spirit, the self-conscious unity of the self and the essence; but both also have the meaning of estrangement for one another.

It is consciousness of an actuality that is free for itself and objective; but over against this consciousness stands that unity of the self and the essence, and over against the actual one stands pure consciousness.

On the one hand actual self-consciousness passes over through its externalization into the actual world, and this world passes back into it; on the other hand, however, this very actuality, both the person and the objectivity, is sublated; they are purely universal.
This estrangement of theirs is pure consciousness, or the essence.
The present has its opposition immediately in its beyond, which is its thinking and its being thought, just as this beyond has it in the this-side, which is its reality estranged from it.
zh: 实体以这种方式就是精神，是自我与本质的自我意识的统一；但两者也都具有彼此异化的含义。
它是对于一个自为地自由的、对象性的现实性的意识；但与这种意识相对而立的，是自我与本质的那种统一，而与现实的那一方相对而立的，则是纯粹意识。
一方面，现实的自我意识通过自己的外化过渡到现实的世界中去，而现实的世界又过渡回自我意识之中；但另一方面，正是这种现实性，无论是人格还是对象性，都被扬弃了；它们是纯粹普遍的。
它们的这种异化就是纯粹意识，或者说就是本质。
当前直接在自己的彼岸拥有对立，这彼岸就是它的思维和被思维；彼岸也同样在此岸拥有对立，而此岸则是彼岸的那种对它已经异化了的现实性。

en: This spirit therefore forms for itself not only a world, but a doubled, separated and opposed one.
– The world of the ethical spirit is its own present, and therefore every power of it is in this unity and, insofar as the two distinguish themselves, in equilibrium with the whole.

Nothing has the meaning of the negative of self-consciousness; even the departed spirit is present in the blood of kinship, in the self of the family, and the universal power of government is the will, the self of the people – but here the present means only objective actuality, which has its consciousness beyond; every single moment as essence receives this and thereby actuality from an other, and insofar as it is actual, its essence is an other than its actuality.

Nothing has a spirit grounded and dwelling in itself, but is outside itself in a foreign one; the equilibrium of the whole is not the unity that stays with itself and its rest returned into itself, but rests on the estrangement of what is opposed.

The whole is therefore, like every single moment, an estranged reality; it falls apart into one realm, in which self-consciousness is actual as both it and its object, and into another, the realm of pure consciousness, which beyond the first has no actual present but is in faith.

Just as the ethical world, out of the separation of the divine and human law and of their shapes, and its consciousness, out of separation into knowing and into unconsciousness, returns into its fate, into the self as the negative power of this opposition, so too will these two realms of the spirit estranged from itself return into the self; but while that first self was the immediately valid self, the single person, this second self, which returns into itself out of its externalization, will be the universal self, the consciousness that grasps the concept, and these spiritual worlds, all of whose moments claim a fixed actuality and a spiritless subsistence of their own, will dissolve in pure insight.

As the self that grasps itself, it completes culture; it takes nothing but the self, and everything as the self, that is, it comprehends everything, cancels all objectivity and transforms all being-in-itself into being-for-itself.
Turned against faith as the foreign realm of essence lying beyond, it is enlightenment.

This enlightenment completes estrangement even in that realm into which the estranged spirit saves itself as into the consciousness of rest equal to itself; it confuses for it the household it here keeps, by bringing into it the utensils of the this-side world, which it cannot disown as its own property, because its consciousness likewise belongs to this world.
– In this negative business, pure insight at the same time realizes itself and brings forth its own object, the unknowable absolute essence and the useful.

Since in this way actuality has lost all substantiality and nothing is any longer in itself in it, the realm of faith as well as that of the real world is overthrown, and this revolution brings forth absolute freedom, with which the spirit, previously estranged, has completely returned into itself, leaves this land of culture and passes over into another land, into the land of moral consciousness.
zh: 因此，这种精神不仅给自己造出一个世界，而且造出一个二重的、分离的、对立的世界。
——伦理精神的世界就是它自己的当前，因此这个世界的每一种力量都处于这种统一之中，而就两者有区别而言，则处于与整体的平衡之中。
没有任何东西具有自我意识的否定物的含义；就连已经逝去的精神也当前存在于亲族的血液中，存在于家庭的自我之中，而政府的普遍力量就是意志，就是人民的自我——但在这里，当前的东西只意味着对象性的现实性，而它的意识在彼岸；每一个作为本质的个别环节都从另一个东西那里接受这一点，并因此接受现实性，而就它是现实的而言，它的本质就是不同于它的现实性的另一个东西。
没有任何东西拥有一种在它自身之内建立起来并寓于其中的精神，相反，它都在一个异己的东西那里外在于自身；整体的平衡并不是那种停留在自身之内的统一及其返回自身的安宁，而是建立在对立之物的异化之上。
因此，整体和每一个别环节一样，是一种自身异化了的实在性；它分裂为一个王国——在其中，自我意识既现实地是这个王国，又是它的对象——以及另一个王国，即纯粹意识的王国，后者在第一个王国之外并没有现实的当前，而是在信仰之中。

正如伦理世界从神的规律和人的规律及其形态的分裂中、它的意识从分裂为知识与无意识之中，返回自己的命运，返回那个作为这种对立的否定力量的自我一样，自身异化了的精神的这两个王国也将返回自我之中；但如果说那第一个自我是直接有效的自我，即单个人格，那么这第二个从自己的外化中返回自身的自我，将是普遍的自我，是把握着概念的意识，而这些精神世界——它们的一切环节都固执于一种固定的现实性和一种无精神的持存——将在纯粹识见中消解。
它作为把握自身的自我，完成了教养；它不把任何东西当作别的，只当作自我，并把一切都当作自我，也就是说，它以概念把握一切，消除一切对象性，并把一切自在存在都转化为自为存在。
它转向信仰，把信仰当作那个异己的、位于彼岸的本质王国，于是它就是启蒙。
这种启蒙在那个王国里——异化了的精神逃入这个王国，就像逃入与自身相同的安宁的意识——也完成了异化；它扰乱了精神在这里操持的家务，因为它把此岸世界的器具搬了进来，而精神不能否认这些器具是自己的财产，因为它的意识同样属于此岸世界。
——在这种否定的活动中，纯粹识见同时把自己实在化，并产生出它自己的对象，即那不可认识的绝对本质和有用之物。
由于现实性以这种方式丧失了一切实体性，其中再也不存在任何自在的东西，所以信仰的王国和实在的世界都倾覆了，而这场革命产生了绝对自由，凭借这种自由，先前异化了的精神已经完全返回自身，离开这块教养的国土，过渡到另一块国土，即道德意识的国土。

28.en: I. The world of spirit estranged from itself
28.zh: I. 自身异化了的精神的世界

en: The world of this spirit falls apart into the doubled world: the first is the world of actuality, or of its estrangement itself; the other, however, is the one that it, raising itself above the first, builds for itself in the ether of pure consciousness.

This other world, opposed to that estrangement, is for that very reason not free of it, but is rather only the other form of estrangement, which consists precisely in having consciousness in two kinds of world, and embracing both.

Thus what is considered here is not the self-consciousness of the absolute essence as it is in and for itself, not religion, but faith, insofar as it is the flight out of the actual world and therefore is not in and for itself.
This flight out of the realm of the present is therefore immediately doubled in itself.

Pure consciousness is the element into which spirit raises itself; but it is not only the element of faith, it is just as much the element of the concept; both therefore enter at the same time with one another, and faith comes into consideration only in opposition to the concept.
zh: 这个精神的世界分裂为二重的世界：第一个是现实性的世界，或者说它自身异化的世界；另一个则是它超越第一个世界、在纯粹意识的以太中为自己建立起来的世界。
这后一个世界与那种异化相对立，正因如此它并不免于异化，而只是异化的另一种形式；这种形式恰恰在于，意识在两种世界中都有，并且把两者都包含在内。
所以这里考察的并不是绝对本质的自在自为的自我意识，不是宗教，而是信仰，就信仰是从现实世界中逃出、因而并非自在自为的而言。
所以这种从当前王国中的逃出，在它自身那里直接就是二重的。
纯粹意识是精神向之上升的元素；但它不只是信仰的元素，同样也是概念的元素，所以两者同时一起出现，而信仰只有在与概念的对立中才被考虑。

30.en: a. Culture and its realm of actuality
30.zh: a. 教养及其现实性的王国

en: The spirit of this world is the spiritual essence pervaded by a self-consciousness, which knows itself as this being-for-itself immediately present and knows the essence as an actuality over against itself.

But the determinate being of this world, as well as the actuality of self-consciousness, rests on the movement whereby the latter externalizes its personality, thereby brings forth its world and behaves towards it as towards something foreign, in such a way that it now has to take possession of it.
But the renunciation of its being-for-itself is itself the production of actuality, and through it, therefore, it immediately takes possession of that actuality.
– Or self-consciousness is something, it has reality, only insofar as it estranges itself; through this it posits itself as universal, and this its universality is its validity and its actuality.

This equality with all is therefore not that equality of right, not that immediate being-recognized and valid self-consciousness – valid because it is – but rather, in order to be valid, it must have made itself conformable to the universal through estranging mediation.
The spiritless universality of right takes up into itself every natural mode of character as of determinate being, and legitimates it.
But the universality that is valid here is the one that has become, and therefore it is actual.
zh: 这个世界的自我意识就是被一个自我意识所渗透的精神本质，它知道自己作为这个自为存在者直接当前，并且知道本质作为一种现实性与自己相对而立。
但这个世界的定在以及自我意识的现实性，都基于这样一种运动：自我意识外化自己的人格性，由此产生出自己的世界，并对这个世界采取一种态度，把它当作一个异己的东西，以至于自己现在必须占有它。
但放弃自己的自为存在，本身就是现实性的产生，而通过这种放弃，它因此直接占有了这个现实性。
——或者说，自我意识只有在自己异化自己的情况下才是某种东西，才具有实在性；它由此把自己设定为普遍的东西，而它的这种普遍性就是它的有效和它的现实性。
所以这种与一切人的等同并不是法权的那种等同，不是那种直接的被承认和有效的自我意识——它仅仅因为存在就有效——相反，它要有效，就得通过异化的中介使自己符合于普遍的东西。
法权的无精神的普遍性把性格和定在的每一种自然方式都接纳进自身，并让它们得到权利。
但这里有效的普遍性是已经生成起来的普遍性，因此它是现实的。

en: What therefore gives the individual validity and actuality here is culture.
Its true original nature and substance is the spirit of the estrangement of natural being.

This externalization is therefore just as much the end as the determinate being of that nature; it is at the same time the means, or the transition, both of the thought substance into actuality and conversely of the determinate individuality into essentiality.
This individuality forms itself into what it is in itself, and only thereby is it in itself and has actual determinate being; as much culture as it has, so much actuality and power.

Although the self as this one knows itself actual here, its actuality nevertheless consists solely in the sublation of the natural self; the originally determinate nature therefore reduces itself to the unessential difference of magnitude, to a greater or lesser energy of the will.

But the end and content of this self belong solely to the universal substance itself and can only be something universal; the particularity of a nature that becomes end and content is something powerless and unactual; it is a kind that labours in vain and ridiculously to put itself into effect; it is the contradiction of giving actuality to the particular, which is immediately the universal.

If therefore individuality is falsely placed in the particularity of nature and character, then no individualities and characters are to be found in the real world; instead the individuals have one and the same determinate being for one another; that supposed individuality is precisely only the meant determinate being, which in this world, in which only what externalizes itself and therefore only the universal obtains actuality, has no permanence.

– The meant is therefore taken for what it is, for a kind. Kind is not quite the same as espèce, “of all nicknames the most dreadful; for it designates mediocrity and expresses the highest degree of contempt”.

But kind, and being good in one's kind, is a German expression that adds to this meaning the honest air as if it were not meant so badly, or else indeed does not yet include in itself the consciousness of what kind is, and what culture and actuality are.
zh: 所以个体在这里获得有效和现实性所依靠的东西，就是教养。
它真正的原初本性和实体，就是自然存在的异化的精神。
所以这种外化既是自然存在的目的，也是它的定在；它同时是手段或过渡，既是思想实体向现实性的过渡，反过来也是特定的个体性向本质性的过渡。
这种个体性把自己教养成为它自在地所是的东西，只有通过这一点它才自在地存在，才有现实的定在；它有多少教养，就有多少现实性和力量。
虽然自我作为这一个在这里知道自己现实，但它的现实性却只在于对自然自我的扬弃；所以原初被规定的自然就缩减为量的非本质差别，缩减为意志的较大或较小的能量。
但自我的目的和内容却只属于普遍实体本身，只能是一种普遍的东西；一种自然之物的特殊性如果成了目的和内容，那就是某种无力的、非现实的东西；它是一种徒然而可笑地费力要把自己付诸实施的种类；它是那种矛盾，即要给特殊的东西以现实性，而这现实性直接就是普遍的东西。
所以，如果错误地把个体性置于自然和性格的特殊性之中，那么在实在的世界里就根本找不到个体性和性格，相反，各个个体彼此之间倒有一种相同的定在；那种被以为的个体性恰恰只是被意谓的定在，而在这个世界里——在这里只有自身外化着的东西、因而只有普遍的东西才获得现实性——这种定在是没有持存的。
——所以被意谓的东西就照它实际所是的样子被看待，被看成一个种类。种类并不完全等于espèce，“在一切绰号中它是最可怕的；因为它标志着平庸，表达出最高程度的蔑视”。
但种类以及在自己的种类中善良，是一个德语说法，它给这层含义添上了那副诚实的表情，仿佛事情并没有被想得那么糟，或者它也实际上还没有在自己内包含这样的意识，即种类是什么，教养和现实性又是什么。

en: What appears in relation to the single individual as its culture is the essential moment of the substance itself, namely the immediate transition of its thought universality into actuality, or the simple soul of that substance, whereby the in-itself is something recognized and is determinate being.
The movement of the self-cultivating individuality is therefore immediately the becoming of that individuality as the universal objective essence, that is, the becoming of the actual world.
This world, although it has become through individuality, is for self-consciousness something immediately estranged and has for it the form of an immovable actuality.

But since it is certainly at the same time conscious that this world is its substance, it sets out to take possession of it; it attains this power over the world through culture, which from this side appears in such a way that the self makes itself conformable to actuality, and as much as the energy of the original character and talent allows it.
What appears here as the violence of the individual, under which the substance comes and is thereby sublated, is the same as what the realization of the latter is.
For the power of the individual consists in this, that it makes itself conformable to that substance, that is, that it externalizes its self, thus posits itself as the objective, existing substance.
Its culture and its own actuality is therefore the realization of the substance itself.
zh: 在与单个个体相关时表现为它的教养的东西，就是实体自身的本质环节，即实体的思想普遍性向现实性的直接过渡，或者说实体的简单灵魂，自在的东西由此成为被承认的东西并且是定在。
所以，自我教养着的个体性的运动，直接就是这种个体性作为普遍的、对象性的本质的生成，也就是说，是现实世界的生成。
这个世界虽然是通过个体性生成起来的，但对自我意识来说却是直接异化了的东西，对它具有不可动摇的现实性的形式。
但正因为它同时也意识到这个世界是它的实体，它就去设法占有这个世界；它通过教养获得对世界的这种支配，而教养从这一方面来看就表现为：自我使自己符合于现实性，并且达到原初性格和才能的能量所允许它的那么多。
这里表现为个体的暴力、实体隶属于它并因此被扬弃的东西，与实体的现实化是同一个东西。
因为个体的力量就在于，它使自己符合于实体，也就是说，它外化自己的自我，从而把自己设定为对象性的、存在着的实体。
所以它的教养和它自己的现实性，就是实体自身的现实化。

en: The self is actual for itself only as sublated.
It therefore does not make up for it the unity of the consciousness of itself and of the object; on the contrary, this object is for it the negative of itself.

– Through the self as the soul, the substance is thus developed in its moments in such a way that the opposed one in-spirits the other, each gives subsistence to the other through its own estrangement and likewise receives it from the other.
At the same time each moment has its determinacy as an insurmountable validity and a firm actuality over against the other.
Thinking fixes this difference in the most universal way through the absolute opposition of good and evil, which, fleeing each other, can in no way become the same.

But this firm being has as its soul the immediate transition into the opposite; determinate being is rather the inversion of every determinacy into its opposite, and only this estrangement is the essence and preservation of the whole.
This realizing movement and in-spiriting of the moments is now to be considered; estrangement will estrange itself, and through it the whole will take itself back into its concept.
zh: 自我只有作为被扬弃的东西才是自为地现实的。
因此，它并不为它构成它自己的意识与对象的统一；相反，这个对象对它是它自己的否定物。
——通过作为灵魂的自我，实体于是在它的各个环节中被培养成这样：对立的一方使另一方具有精神，每一方都通过自己的异化而给另一方以持存，并且同样从另一方那里获得持存。
同时，每一个环节都拥有自己的规定性，作为对另一方来说一种不可克服的有效性和一种坚固的现实性。
思维以最普遍的方式把这种差别固定下来，靠的是善与恶的绝对对立，而善与恶互相躲避，绝不能成为同一个东西。
但这种坚固的存在以向对立面的直接过渡为自己的灵魂；定在毋宁说就是每一种规定性向它的对立面的颠倒，而只有这种异化才是整体的本质和保持。
这种使各个环节现实化的运动和使之具有精神的运动，现在要加以考察；异化将把自己异化，而整体将通过异化把自己收回自己的概念之中。

en: First the simple substance itself is to be considered in the immediate organization of its existent, still unspirited moments.

– As nature expounds itself into the universal elements – among which air is the persisting, purely universal transparent essence, while water is the essence that is always being sacrificed, fire their animating unity, which just as constantly dissolves their opposition as it sunders its simplicity into that opposition, and earth, finally, is the firm knot of this articulation and the subject of these essences as of their process, their issuing forth and their return –, so in just such universal but spiritual masses the inner essence or the simple spirit of self-conscious actuality expounds itself as a world: into the first mass, the in-itself universal, self-equal spiritual essence; into the other, the being-for-itself, in itself unequal, self-sacrificing and self-devoting essence; and into the third, which as self-consciousness is subject and has the power of fire immediately on itself.
In the first essence it is conscious of itself as of the in-itself; in the second, however, it has the becoming of being-for-itself through the sacrifice of the universal.

But the spirit itself is the being-in-and-for-itself of the whole, which divides itself into the substance as persisting and into it as self-sacrificing and likewise takes it back again into its unity, both as the flame that breaks out and consumes it and as the persisting shape of the same.

– We see that these essences correspond to the commonwealth and to the family of the ethical world, without, however, possessing the native spirit that these have; on the other hand, if fate is foreign to this spirit, self-consciousness here is and knows itself as the actual power of these essences.
zh: 首先要考察简单的实体本身，即考察它那些定在着的、还没有精神的环节的直接组织。

——正如自然把自己展布为那些普遍的元素——其中空气是持存的、纯粹普遍的、透明的本质，水则是那永远被牺牲的本质，火是它们赋予灵魂的统一，它同样经常地消解它们的对立，正如它把自己的单纯性分裂为这种对立，而土最终是这种划分的坚固纽结，是这些本质以及它们的过程、它们的出来和它们的返回的主体——，同样，自我意识的现实性的内在本质或简单精神，也把自己展布为一个世界，展布为这样一些普遍的、但却是精神性的质量：展布为第一个质量，即自在地普遍的、自身相同的、精神性的本质；展布为另一个质量，即自为地存在的、在自身内变得不相等的、自我牺牲和献身的本质；并且展布为第三个质量，它作为自我意识是主体，并且直接在自己身上拥有火的势力。
在第一个本质中，它意识到自己作为自在存在；但在第二个本质中，它则通过普遍东西的牺牲而拥有自为存在的生成。
但精神本身是整体的自在自为存在，它把自己分裂为作为持存着的实体和作为自我牺牲的实体，并且同样又把它们收回到自己的统一之中，既作为迸发出来、把它吞掉的火焰，又作为它的持存形态。
——我们看到，这些本质与伦理世界的共同体和家庭相对应，但并不具有后者所拥有的那种本土的精神；与此相反，如果说命运对这种精神是陌生的，那么在这里，自我意识就是并且知道自己就是这些本质的现实的势力。

en: These members are to be considered both as they are initially within pure consciousness as thoughts or as in-itself existent, and as they are represented in actual consciousness as objective essences.

– In that form of simplicity, the first, as the self-equal, immediate and unchanging essence of all consciousness, is the good – the independent spiritual power of the in-itself, in which the movement of the being-for-itself consciousness merely plays along.

The other, by contrast, is the passive spiritual essence, or the universal insofar as it gives itself up and lets the individuals take on it the consciousness of their singularity; it is the null essence, evil.

– This absolute dissolution of the essence is itself persisting; as the first essence is the ground, the starting point and the result of the individuals, and these are purely universal in it, so the second is on the one hand the self-sacrificing being for another, and on the other hand, precisely for that reason, their constant return to themselves as the singular, and their persisting becoming-for-itself.
zh: 这些环节既要按照它们最初在纯粹意识之内作为思想或作为自在存在的东西的样子来考察，也要按照它们在现实意识中作为对象性的本质而被表象的样子来考察。
——在那种单纯性的形式中，第一个环节作为一切意识一般的、自身相同的、直接的、不变的本质，就是善——即自在的、独立的精神势力，而自为存在着的意识的运动在它那里只是顺带进行。
与此相反，另一个环节则是被动的精神本质，或者说普遍东西，就它放弃自己、并让各个个体在它那里取得自己个别性的意识而言；它是有等于无的本质，即恶。
——本质的这种绝对的消解本身是持存的；正如第一个本质是个体的基础、出发点和结果，而个体在它那里是纯粹普遍的，第二个本质则一方面是自我牺牲的为他存在，另一方面恰恰因此又是它们作为个别东西向自身的持续返回，是它们持存的自为生成。

en: But these simple thoughts of the good and the evil are likewise immediately estranged from themselves; they are actual, and in actual consciousness as objective moments.
Thus the first essence is state power, the other wealth.

– State power is, like the simple substance, the universal work, the absolute matter itself, in which the essence of the individuals is expressed and their singularity is purely and simply only consciousness of their universality; it is likewise the work and simple result, from which this, that it comes from their doing, disappears; it remains the absolute ground and subsistence of all their doing.
– This simple ethereal substance of their life is, through this determination of its unchanging self-equality, being, and thereby only being for another.
It is therefore in itself immediately the opposite of itself, wealth.

Although wealth is the passive or the null, it is likewise universal spiritual essence, just as much the constantly becoming result of the labor and the doing of all, as it again dissolves into the enjoyment of all.

In enjoyment, individuality is indeed for itself or as singular, but this enjoyment itself is the result of the universal doing, just as it reciprocally brings forth the universal labor and the enjoyment of all.
The actual has purely and simply the spiritual meaning of being immediately universal.

In this moment every single individual no doubt means to act self-servingly; for it is the moment in which he gives himself the consciousness of being for himself, and he therefore does not take it for something spiritual; yet even merely viewed externally it shows itself that in his enjoyment everyone gives everyone to enjoy, in his labor works just as much for all as for himself, and all work for him.

His being-for-itself is therefore in itself universal, and self-interest something merely meant, which cannot get so far as to make actual what it means, namely to do something that would not benefit all.
zh: 但善和恶这些简单的思想同样直接地自身异化了；它们是现实的，并且在现实意识中作为对象性的环节。
所以，第一个本质是国家权力，另一个则是财富。
——国家权力和简单实体一样，是普遍的作品、绝对的事情本身，在它之中，个体的本质被说了出来，而它们的个别性绝对只是对它们普遍性的意识；它同样是作品和简单结果，而它来自它们的行动这一点在结果中消失了；它始终是它们一切行动的绝对基础和持存。
——它们生命的这种简单的以太般的实体，由于它的不变的自相等的这种规定性，就是存在，并因此只是为他存在。
所以它自在地直接就是它自己的对立面，即财富。
财富虽然是被动的或无的东西，但它同样是普遍的精神本质，同样是一切人的劳动和行动的不断生成的结果，正如它又重新消解为一切人的享受。
在享受中，个体性固然是自为的或作为个别的东西，但这种享受本身就是普遍行动的结果，正如它反过来又产生出普遍的劳动和一切人的享受。
现实的东西绝对具有直接是普遍的这种精神意义。
在这个环节中，每一个个别的个体无疑都意谓着要自利地行动；因为这是它给自己以为自己存在着的意识的环节，所以它不把这种行动当作某种精神性的东西；但即使只从外部看，也表明：在他的享受中，每个人都让所有人享受，在他的劳动中，他既为自己也为所有人劳动，而所有人也为他劳动。
所以，他的自为存在自在地就是普遍的，而自利则只是被意谓的东西，它不能做到把自己所意谓的东西变成现实，即去做一件对所有人没有好处的事。

en: In these two spiritual powers, therefore, self-consciousness cognizes its substance, content and purpose; it beholds its double essence in them, in the one its being-in-itself, in the other its being-for-itself.
– But as spirit it is at the same time the negative unity of their subsistence and of the separation of individuality and the universal, or of actuality and the self.

Lordship and wealth are therefore present for the individual as objects, that is, as such that it knows itself free from them and believes it can choose between them, and even choose neither of the two.
As this free and pure consciousness, it steps over against the essence as such a one as is only for it.
It then has the essence as essence within itself.
– In this pure consciousness the moments of the substance are for it not state power and wealth, but the thoughts of good and evil.
– But self-consciousness is further the relation of its pure consciousness to its actual one, of the thought to the objective essence; it is essentially the judgment.

– To be sure, it has already turned out for the two sides of the actual essence, through their immediate determinations, which is the good and which the evil: the former state power, the latter wealth.

But this first judgment cannot be regarded as a spiritual judgment; for in it the one side has been determined only as the in-itself-existing or positive, the other only as the for-itself-existing and negative.

But as spiritual essences, each is the interpenetration of both moments, hence not exhausted in those determinations, and the self-consciousness that relates to them is in and for itself, so it must relate to each in the doubled way, whereby their nature, to be determinations estranged from themselves, will come to light.
zh: 所以，在这两种精神势力中，自我意识认识到自己的实体、内容和目的；它在这两者中直观到自己的二重本质，在一种势力中直观到自己的自在存在，在另一种势力中直观到自己的自为存在。
——但它作为精神，同时是它们的持存、以及个体性与普遍东西或现实性与自我的分离的否定统一。
所以，统治和财富对个体来说是作为对象而现成存在的，也就是说，是作为这样的对象：个体知道自己对它们是自由的，并且认为自己能够在它们之间作出选择，甚至能够两者都不选。
它作为这种自由而纯粹的意识，与那种只对它来说才存在的本质相对而立。
它于是就在自身之内拥有作为本质的本质。
——在这种纯粹意识中，实体的那些环节对它来说并不是国家权力和财富，而是善与恶的思想。
——但自我意识进一步来说，是它那纯粹的意识对它那现实的意识的关系，是被思想的东西对对象性本质的关系，它本质上就是判断。
——诚然，对于现实的本质的两个方面，通过它们的直接规定，已经得出哪一个是善、哪一个是恶；前者是国家权力，后者是财富。
但这个最初的判断不能看作一种精神的判断；因为在它之中，一方只被规定为自在存在着的东西或肯定物，另一方只被规定为自为存在着的东西和否定物。
但它们作为精神性的本质，每一个都是两个环节的相互渗透，因而并未穷尽于那些规定之中，而那种与它们发生关联的自我意识是自在自为的，所以它必须对每一个都以双重的方式发生关联，由此它们的本性，即成为自身异化了的规定，就会显露出来。

en: For self-consciousness, now, that object is good and in itself in which it finds itself, but that one is evil in which it finds the opposite of itself; the good is the equality of objective reality with it, the evil its inequality.

At the same time, what is good and evil for it is good and evil in itself; for it is precisely that in which these two moments, of being-in-itself and of being-for-it, are the same; it is the actual spirit of the objective essences, and the judgment is the demonstration of its power over them, which makes them into what they are in themselves.

Not this, how they immediately in themselves are the equal or the unequal, that is, abstract being-in-itself or being-for-itself, is their criterion and their truth, but what they are in the relation of spirit to them: their equality or inequality with it.

Its relation to them, which are at first posited as objects and through it become the in-itself, becomes at the same time their reflection into themselves, through which they receive actual spiritual being and what their spirit is comes forth.
But just as their first immediate determination differs from the relation of spirit to them, so too the third, their own spirit, will differ from the second.

– Their second in-itself, to begin with, which comes forth through the relation of spirit to them, must already turn out different from the immediate one, for this mediation of spirit rather sets the immediate determinacy in motion and makes it into something other.
zh: 现在，对自我意识来说，那个它在其中找到自己的对象是善的、并且是自在的，而那个它在其中找到自身对立面的对象则是恶的；善是对象性的实在性与它的一致，恶则是这种实在性与它的不一致。
同时，对它来说善的和恶的东西，自在地也是善的和恶的；因为它恰恰就是自在存在与为它存在这两个环节在其中是同一个东西的那种东西；它是对象性诸本质的现实的精神，而判断则是它的力量在这些本质身上的证明，这种力量把它们造成它们自在地所是的东西。
它们的标准和真理并不是它们直接地自在地就是相等的或不相等的东西、也就是抽象的自在存在或自为存在这一点，而是它们在与精神的关系中是什么：它们与精神的一致或不一致。
它对它们的关系，即它们起初被设定为对象、并通过它而成为自在的东西，同时成为它们对自身的反思，通过这种反思，它们获得现实的、精神性的存在，而它们的精神是什么也就显露出来。
但正如它们最初的那个直接规定不同于精神对它们的关系，那第三个东西，即它们自己的精神，也将不同于第二个东西。
——首先是它们的第二个自在存在，它通过精神对它们的关系而显露出来，必定已经不同于那个直接的自在存在，因为精神的这种中介毋宁说使那个直接的规定性运动起来，并把它变成另一个东西。

en: Accordingly, the consciousness that is in and for itself finds in state power indeed its simple essence and subsistence in general, but not its individuality as such, indeed its being-in-itself, not its being-for-itself; it finds therein rather doing as singular doing disowned and subjugated to obedience.

The individual therefore reflects itself into itself before this power; it is for it the suppressing essence and the evil; for instead of being the equal, it is what is absolutely unequal to individuality.
– Wealth, by contrast, is the good; it aims at universal enjoyment, gives itself up, and procures for all the consciousness of their self.

It is in itself universal beneficence; if it refuses some benefit and is not obliging towards every need, this is a contingency that does no prejudice to its universal necessary essence, to share itself with all singular ones and to be a thousand-handed giver.
zh: 据此，自在自为地存在着的意识在国家权力中固然找到自己简单的本质和一般的持存，却找不到它作为这样的个体性，固然找到自己的自在存在，却找不到自己的自为存在；它毋宁说在其中发现，行动作为个别的行动遭到否认，并被压服为顺从。
所以，个体在这种权力面前反思到自身之内；这种权力对它来说就是压制性的本质，就是恶；因为它并不是那个相等的东西，而是与个体性绝对不相等的东西。
——相反，财富则是善；它着眼于普遍的享受，把自己交出去，并使所有人都获得他们自我的意识。
它自在地就是普遍的善行；如果它拒绝某种善举，并不肯对每一种需要都予以满足，那么这只是一种偶然性，无损于它那普遍的、必然的本质，即把自己分给一切个别者、做千手的给予者。

en: These two judgments give the thoughts of good and evil a content that is the opposite of the one they had for us.
– But self-consciousness has so far related itself to its objects only incompletely, namely only according to the standard of being-for-itself.
But consciousness is equally an in-itself-existing essence and must likewise make this side into the standard, whereby the spiritual judgment is first completed.

According to this side, state power expresses to it its essence; it is partly resting law, partly government and command, which orders the individual movements of the universal doing; the one the simple substance itself, the other its doing, which animates and preserves itself and all.
The individual therefore finds therein its ground and essence expressed, organized and set in activity.

– By contrast, through the enjoyment of wealth it does not experience its universal essence, but receives only the transient consciousness and the enjoyment of itself as a being-for-itself singularity and of the inequality with its essence.
– The concepts of good and evil thus receive here the content opposite to the previous one.
zh: 这两个判断给善与恶的思想提供了一个内容，这个内容与它们对我们来说曾具有的内容相反。
——但自我意识只是不完整地与它的对象发生了关联，也就是说，只是按照自为存在的尺度。
但意识同样是自在存在着的本质，并且也必须把这一面当作尺度，由此精神的判断才得以完成。
从这一面来看，国家权力向它说出它的本质；它一方面是静止的法则，另一方面是政府和命令，而命令则安排着普遍行动的诸个别运动；前者是简单的实体本身，后者则是它那种赋予自身和一切以生命、并保存自身和一切的行动。
所以，个体在其中发现自己的根据和本质得到表达、得到组织、并得到发挥。
——相反，通过享受财富，它经验到的并不是自己普遍的本质，而只是获得那转瞬即逝的意识，以及获得对自身的享受，即把自己当作自为存在的单一性、当作与自己的本质不相等的东西来享受。
——所以，善与恶的概念在这里获得了与先前相反的内容。

en: These two ways of judging each find an equality and an inequality: the first judging consciousness finds the state power unequal, the enjoyment of wealth equal with it; the second, on the other hand, finds the former equal and the latter unequal with it.
There is a twofold finding-equal and a twofold finding-unequal, an opposed relation to the two real essentialities.
– We must ourselves judge this different judging, for which we have to apply the standard that has been set up.

The finding-equal relation of consciousness is accordingly the good, the finding-unequal the bad; and these two ways of relation are now themselves to be held fast as different shapes of consciousness.

By comporting itself in different ways, consciousness itself comes under the determination of difference, of being good or bad – not by having either being-for-itself or pure being-in-itself as its principle, for both are equally essential moments; the doubled judging that was considered presented the principles separately and therefore contains only abstract ways of judging.
Actual consciousness has both principles on it, and the difference falls solely into its essence, namely into the relation of itself to the real.
zh: 这两种判断方式各自都找到一种相等和一种不相等：第一个作判断的意识发现国家权力与它不相等，而财富的享受与它相等；第二个则相反，发现前者与它相等，后者与它不相等。
这里存在着一种双重的认为相等和一种双重的认为不相等，即一种对两个实在的本质的对立关系。
——我们必须对这种不同的判断本身下判断，为此我们要把已经树立起来的尺度用上去。
意识的那种认为相等的关系据此就是善，认为不相等的关系就是恶；而这两种关系方式现在本身要作为意识的不同形态固定下来。
意识由于以不同的方式行事，自己就落到差别这个规定之下，即落到是善还是恶的规定之下，而不是因为它把自为存在或纯粹自在存在当作原则，因为两者是同等本质的环节；刚才考察的那种双重的判断把两个原则分开来表象，因此只包含抽象的判断方式。
现实的意识自身具有两个原则，而差别只落在它的本质里，即落在它自己与实在物的关系里。

en: The mode of this relation is the opposed one: the one is a comportment toward state power and wealth as toward something equal, the other as toward something unequal.
– The consciousness of the finding-equal relation is the noble-minded one.
