In the public power it considers the element equal to it, namely that in it it has its simple essence and the activity of that essence, and stands in the service of actual obedience as well as of inner respect toward it.

Likewise in wealth, that it procures for it the consciousness of its other essential side, of being-for-itself; therefore it likewise considers wealth as an essence in relation to itself and recognizes the one from whom it enjoys as a benefactor and holds itself obliged to gratitude.
zh: 这种关系的方式是对立的方式：一种是对国家权力和财富的态度，把它们当作与自己相等的东西，另一种则把它们当作与自己不相等的东西。
——认为相等的那种关系的意识就是高贵的意识。
在公共权力中，它看到与自己相等的东西，即它在公共权力中拥有自己的简单本质和这本质的活动，并且处在现实的服从、也处在对公共权力的内心敬重的服务之中。
同样，在财富中它看到与自己相等的东西，即财富为它提供了对它另一个本质方面、即自为存在的意识；因此它同样把财富看作与自己相关的本质，并且把那个它从之得到享受的人承认为恩人，认为自己有感恩的义务。

en: The consciousness of the other relation, by contrast, is the ignoble one, which holds fast to the inequality with the two essentialities, thus sees in the ruling power a fetter and a suppression of being-for-itself and therefore hates the ruler, obeys only with treachery and is always on the verge of revolt, – in wealth, through which it attains the enjoyment of its being-for-itself, it likewise considers only the inequality, namely with the persisting essence; since through wealth it comes only to the consciousness of singleness and of transient enjoyment, it loves wealth but despises it, and with the disappearance of the enjoyment, of what in itself disappears, it regards its relation to the rich man as likewise vanished.
zh: 相反，另一种关系的意识是卑贱的意识，它固守与两个本质的不相等，于是在统治权力中看到对自为存在的一种束缚和压制，因此憎恨统治者，只是怀着阴险去服从，并且总是随时准备叛乱，——在财富中，它虽然通过财富达到对自己自为存在的享受，却同样只看到不相等，即与那持存的本质不相等；由于它通过财富只达到对个别性和短暂享受的意识，它就爱财富却又鄙视财富，并且随着享受、即随着那自在地消逝着的东西的消逝，它也认为自己与富人的关系已经消逝了。

en: These relations now express for the first time the judgment, but not yet the determination, in and for itself, of what the two essences are as objects for consciousness.

The reflection that is presented in the judgment is, on the one hand, only for us a positing of the one as well as of the other determination, and hence an equal sublating of both, not yet the reflection of these for consciousness itself.

On the other hand, they are at first immediately essence, neither become this nor self-consciousness in them; that for which they are is not yet their animation; they are predicates that are not yet themselves subject.
Because of this separation, the whole of spiritual judging also still falls apart into two consciousnesses, each of which lies under a one-sided determination.

– Just as at first the indifference of the two sides of estrangement – the one, the in-itself of pure consciousness, namely the determinate thoughts of good and evil; the other, its determinate being as state power and wealth – raised itself to the relation of both, to judgment, so must this external relation raise itself to inner unity, or as the relation of thought to actuality, and the spirit of the two shapes of judgment must come forth.
This happens in that the judgment becomes a syllogism, becomes the mediating movement in which the necessity and the middle of the two sides of the judgment come forth.
zh: 这些关系现在才表达出判断，还没有表达出那两个本质作为意识的对象是什么这一自在自为的规定。
在判断中被表象的那种反思，一方面还只是对我们而言设定这一规定以及另一规定，因而是对两者的同等扬弃，还不是这些规定对意识本身的反思。
另一方面，它们还只是直接的本质，既没有成为这个，在它们身上也还没有自我意识；它们所为之而存在的那一方，还没有使它们活起来；它们是还没有自身成为主体的谓词。
由于这种分离，精神的判断的整体也还分裂为两个意识，其中每一个都处于一种片面的规定之下。
——正如异化的两个方面——一个是纯粹意识的自在，即关于善与恶的特定思想；另一个是它作为国家权力和财富的定在——的漠不相关，最初把自己提升为两者的关系、提升为判断，同样，这种外在的关系也必须把自己提升为内在的统一，或者提升为思维与现实性的关系，而两种判断形态的精神也必须出现。
这种情况的发生在于，判断成为推论，成为中介的运动，在其中判断两个方面的必然性和中项显露出来。

en: The noble-minded consciousness therefore finds itself in the judgment so placed over against the state power that the latter is indeed not yet a self but only the universal substance, of which, however, it is conscious as of its essence, as of the end and absolute content.
Relating itself thus positively to it, it behaves negatively toward its own ends, its particular content and determinate being, and lets them vanish.

It is the heroism of service, – the virtue that sacrifices singular being to the universal and thereby brings the universal into determinate being, – the person that of itself renounces possession and enjoyment and acts and is actual for the power that exists.
zh: 所以，高贵的意识在判断中发现自己这样地与国家权力相对而立：国家权力虽然还不是一个自我，而只是普遍的实体，但意识却把这实体当作自己的本质、当作目的和绝对内容而意识到它。
它这样肯定地对待国家权力，就否定地对待自己的目的、自己的特殊内容和定在，并让它们消逝。
这就是服务的英雄主义，——即那种把个别存在献给普遍、并由此把普遍带入定在的德行，——即那个人格，它自己放弃占有和享受，为现存的权力而行动并因而现实地存在。

en: Through this movement the universal is joined together with determinate being in general, just as the existing consciousness through this externalization forms itself into essentiality.

What it estranges from itself in service is its consciousness sunk into determinate being; but the estranged being is the in-itself; hence through this formation it receives respect for itself and among others.
– But the state power, which was at first only the thought universal, the in-itself, becomes through this very movement the existing universal, the actual power.
It is this only in the actual obedience that it attains through the judgment of self-consciousness that it is the essence, and through the free sacrifice of the same.
This doing, which joins the essence with the self, brings forth the doubled actuality: itself as that which has true actuality, and the state power as the true which holds good.
zh: 通过这一运动，普遍的东西与一般的定在联结起来，正如定在着的意识通过这种外化把自己教养为本质性。
它在服务中从自身异化出去的东西，是它沉浸于定在之中的意识；但被异化出去的存在却是自在；所以它通过这种教养获得对自己的敬重，也获得别人的敬重。
——但国家权力，它起初还只是被思考的普遍东西、即自在，如今通过正是这一运动成为存在着的普遍东西、成为现实的权力。
它只有在现实的服从中才是这种权力，而这种服从是它通过自我意识的判断——即它是本质这一判断——并通过自我意识的自由牺牲而获得的。
这种把本质与自我联结在一起的行为，产生出双重的现实性：它自己作为具有真的现实性的东西，以及国家权力作为那个有效准的真的东西。

en: But through this estrangement this [state power] is not yet a self-consciousness that knows itself as state power; only its law or its in-itself is what holds; it has as yet no particular will, for the serving self-consciousness has not yet externalized its pure self and thereby inspirited the state power, but only with its being; it has sacrificed to the state power only its determinate being, not its being-in-itself.
– This self-consciousness counts as one that is in accordance with the essence; it is recognized on account of its being-in-itself.
The others find in it their essence realized in action, but not their being-for-itself; they find their thinking or pure consciousness fulfilled, but not their individuality.
It therefore counts in their thoughts and enjoys honor.

It is the proud vassal who is active for the state power insofar as this is not a will of its own but something more essential, and who counts only in this honor, only in the essential representing of the general opinion, not in the grateful representing of individuality, for he has not helped the latter to its being-for-itself.
Its speech, if it were to comport itself toward the state power's own will, which has not yet come to be, would be the counsel that it gives for the general good.
zh: 但国家权力通过这种异化还不是一个把自己知为国家权力的自我意识；有效的只是它的规律或它的自在；它还没有特殊的意志，因为服务的自我意识还没有外化自己纯粹的自我、并由此使国家权力有了精神，而还只是以自己的存在来这样做；它为国家权力牺牲的只是自己的定在，不是自己的自在存在。
——这种自我意识被看作符合本质的自我意识，它因为自己的自在存在而得到承认。
其他人在它身上发现自己的本质得到了实现，却没有发现自己的自为存在——他们发现自己的思维或纯粹意识得到了充实，却没有发现自己的个体性。
所以它就在他们的思想中有效，并享受着荣誉。
它是那个骄傲的封臣，它为着国家权力而活动，只要国家权力不是它自己的意志、而是更本质的东西；它只在荣誉中才有效，只在普遍意见的那种本质性的表象中有效，而不在个体性那种感激的表象中有效，因为它并没有帮助个体性达到它的自为存在。
如果它针对国家权力那种自己的、还没有形成的意志而说话，那么它的话就是它为普遍福祉所给出的劝告。

en: The state power is therefore still without will in the face of the counsel and does not decide between the various opinions about the general good.
It is not yet government and thus not yet truly actual state power.

– Being-for-itself, the will that as will is not yet sacrificed, is the inner, withdrawn spirit of the estates, which over against its speaking of the general good reserves for itself its own particular good and is inclined to make this idle talk about the general good a surrogate for action.

The sacrifice of determinate being that happens in service is indeed complete when it has gone as far as death; but the endured danger of death itself, which is survived, leaves over a particular determinate being and with it a particular being-for-itself, which makes the counsel for the general good ambiguous and suspect and in fact reserves for itself its own opinion and particular will against the state authority.
It therefore still comports itself unequally toward it and falls under the determination of the ignoble consciousness, of always standing on the verge of revolt.
zh: 所以国家权力面对劝告还没有意志，也不在各种关于普遍福祉的意见之间作决断。
它还不是政府，因而还不是在真理中现实的国家权力。
——自为存在，即那个作为意志还没有被牺牲掉的意志，是各等级内心的、隐退的精神，它面对自己关于普遍福祉的谈论，为自己保留自己特殊的福祉，并且倾向于把这种关于普遍福祉的空谈变成行动的替代品。
在服务中发生的定在的牺牲，如果一直进行到死，虽然是完整的；但所经受的死亡危险本身，既然活了下来，就留下一个特定的定在，因而留下一个特殊的自为，这使为普遍福祉所给的劝告变得含混可疑，并且实际上针对国家权威为自己保留了己见和特殊的意志。
所以它对待国家权力仍然是不相等的，并落入卑贱的意识的规定之下，即总是随时准备叛乱。

en: This contradiction, which it has to sublate, contains in this form – that of standing in the inequality of being-for-itself over against the universality of the state power – at the same time the form that that externalization of determinate being, in completing itself, namely in death, is itself a subsisting one, not one that returns into consciousness – that this consciousness does not survive it and is not in and for itself, but passes over only into the unreconciled opposite.

The true sacrifice of being-for-itself is therefore solely that in which it gives itself up as completely as in death, yet in this externalization preserves itself just as much; it thereby becomes actual as what it is in itself, as the identical unity of itself and of itself as the opposite.

By the fact that the withdrawn inner spirit, the self as such, steps forth and estranges itself, the state power is at the same time raised to a self of its own; just as without this estrangement the actions of honor, of the noble consciousness, and the counsels of its insight would remain the ambiguous thing that would still have that withdrawn hiding-place of particular intention and self-will.
zh: 这个它必须加以扬弃的矛盾，在它处于自为存在与国家权力之普遍性的不相等之中这一形式里，同时也包含这样的形式：定在的那种外化在它于死亡中完成自身时，本身是一个存在着的、而不是返回到意识中去的外化——即这个意识并没有活过这种外化、也并不是自在自为的，而只是过渡到没有和解的对立面之中。
所以自为存在的真正牺牲只能是这样的牺牲：它在其中像在死亡中那样完全地放弃自己，但同时又在这种外化中同样多地保存自己；它由此就成为现实的，即成为它自在所是的东西，成为它自身和作为对立面的它自身的同一统一。
由于那隐退的内心精神、即作为自我的自我显露出来并异化自身，国家权力同时也被提升为它自己的自我；正如没有这种异化，荣誉的行动、高贵意识的行动以及它的识见所给的劝告就会仍然是那种含混的东西，而那种东西还会有特殊意图和固执任性的那个隐退的藏身处。

en: But this estrangement happens solely in language, which here appears in its peculiar significance.

– In the world of ethical life law and command, in the world of actuality only counsel at first, it has the essence as its content and is the form of that essence; here, however, it receives the form that it is itself as content and counts as language; it is the force of speaking as such that carries out what is to be carried out.
For it is the determinate being of the pure self as self; in it the being-for-itself singleness of self-consciousness as such enters into existence, so that it is for others.

The I as this pure I is otherwise not there; in every other expression it is sunk in an actuality and in a shape out of which it can withdraw into itself; it is reflected into itself out of its action as out of its physiognomic expression, and lets such incomplete determinate being, in which there is always just as much too much as too little, lie there soulless.
Language, however, contains it in its purity; language alone utters the I, it itself.
This its determinate being is, as determinate being, an objectivity that has its true nature on it.
The I is this I – but just as much a universal one; its appearing is just as immediately the externalization and the disappearance of this I, and thereby its persisting in its universality.
The I that utters itself is heard; it is an infection in which it has immediately passed over into unity with those for whom it is there, and is universal self-consciousness.

– That it is heard: in this its determinate being has itself immediately died away; this its otherness is taken back into itself; and precisely this is its determinate being, as self-conscious Now, that, as it is there, it is not there and through this disappearance is there.

This disappearance is therefore itself immediately its persisting; it is its own knowing of itself and its knowing of itself as a self that has passed over into another self, that has been heard and is universal.
zh: 但这种异化只发生在语言中，语言在这里是以它特有的含义出现的。
——在伦理的世界里它是规律和命令，在现实性的世界里它起初只是劝告，它以本质为内容，并且是本质的形式；但在这里，它把那个它就是的形式本身取作内容，并作为语言而有效；正是说话作为说话的那种力，实行着那应当实行的东西。
因为它就是纯粹自我的定在，即作为自我的定在；在它之中，自我意识那种自为存在着的个别性作为这样的个别性进入存在，以致它是为着别人的。
作为这个纯粹自我的我，在其他情况下并不在那里；在任何别的表现中，它都沉入一种现实性和一种形态之中，而它可以从这种形态中退回自身；它从自己的行动、也从自己面相的表现中反思到自身之内，并且让这种不完整的定在——其中总是既有太多也有太少——失去灵魂地躺在那里。
但语言却把它包含在它的纯粹性中，唯独语言说出我，说出它本身。
它的这个定在作为定在是一种对象性，这种对象性在它身上具有它的真的本性。
我就是这个我——但同样是普遍的我，它的显现同样直接地就是这个我的外化和消失，并因此是它在它的普遍性中的持存。
说出自身的我被人听见了，这是一种传染，我在其中直接地过渡到与那些我为之而在的人的统一，并且成为普遍的自我意识。
——它被听见，它的定在本身在其中就直接地消逝了，它的这个他在被收回自身之中；而这恰恰就是它的定在：作为自我意识着的这时，它正如它存在着那样，并不存在，并且通过这种消失而存在。
所以这种消失本身就是直接地持存；它就是它自己对自己的知识，以及它对自己作为一个已经过渡到别的自我之中、已经被听见并成为普遍的自我的知识。

en: Spirit here receives this actuality because the extremes, whose unity it is, have just as immediately the determination to be actualities of their own for themselves.
Their unity is decomposed into brittle sides, each of which is, for the other, an actual object excluded from it.

The unity therefore emerges as a middle that is excluded and distinguished from the separated actuality of the sides; it therefore itself has an actual objectivity distinguished from its sides and is for them, that is, it is something that has determinate being.

Spiritual substance as such enters into existence only by having won for its sides such self-consciousnesses as know this pure self as immediately valid actuality and therein know just as immediately that they are this only through the estranging mediation.

Through the former the moments are purified into the self-knowing category and thereby to the point that they are moments of spirit; through the latter it enters into determinate being as spirituality.

– It is thus the middle that presupposes those extremes and is produced through their determinate being, – but just as much the spiritual whole breaking forth between them, which divides itself into them and produces each, only through this contact, into a whole in its principle.

– That the two extremes are already in themselves sublated and decomposed brings forth their unity, and this unity is the movement that closes both together, exchanges their determinations, and closes them together, and indeed in each extreme.
This mediation hereby posits the concept of each of the two extremes into its actuality, or it makes what each is in itself into its spirit.
zh: 精神在这里获得这种现实性，因为那些以它为统一的极端，也同样直接地具有这样的规定：自为地成为它们自己的现实性。
它们的统一分解为一些坚硬而互不相容的方面，其中每一个对另一个来说都是现实的、被它排除在外的对象。
所以统一就作为一个中项出现，它被排除在各方那分离出去的现实性之外，并且与之区别开来；因此它自己也具有一种现实的、与它的各个方面区别开来的对象性，并且是为着它们的，也就是说，它是定在着的东西。
精神性的实体作为这样的实体进入存在，只是因为它已经为自己的各个方面赢得了这样的自我意识：这些自我意识把这种纯粹自我知为直接有效准的现实性，并且在其中同样直接地知道，它们只有通过异化着的中介才是这样的。
通过前者，这些环节被纯化为知道自身的范畴，并因此被纯化到这样的地步：它们是精神的环节；通过后者，它作为精神性进入定在。
——它就这样是中项，它预设那些极端，并且通过它们的定在而产生，——但同样也是在它们之间迸发出来的精神整体，它把自己分裂到它们之中，并且只有通过这种接触才把每一个产生为它原则中的整体。
——两个极端已经自在地被扬弃、被分解，这产生出它们的统一，而这种统一就是那种运动：它把两者结合起来，交换它们的规定，并且把它们结合起来，而且是在每一个极端中结合起来。
这种中介由此把两个极端中每一个的概念设定到它的现实性之中，或者说，它把每一个自在地所是的东西变成它的精神。

en: The two extremes, the state power and the noble consciousness, are dissolved by this, – the former into the abstract universal that is obeyed, and into the will that exists for itself, which however does not yet itself belong to it, – the latter into the obedience of sublated determinate being, or into the being-in-itself of self-respect and honour, and into the not yet sublated pure being-for-itself, the will that still remains in ambush.

The two moments to which both sides have been purified and which are therefore moments of language are the abstract universal, which is called the general good, and the pure self, which in service renounced its consciousness sunk into manifold determinate being.
Both are in the concept the same; for the pure self is precisely the abstract universal, and therefore their unity is posited as their middle.

But the self is only first actual at the extreme of consciousness, – the in-itself, however, only at the extreme of the state power; consciousness lacks this, that the state power would have passed over to it not only as honour but actually, the state power lacks this, that it would be obeyed not only as the so-called general good but as will, or that it is the deciding self.

The unity of the concept in which the state power still stands and to which consciousness has purified itself becomes actual in this mediating movement, whose simple determinate being, as middle, is language.

– However, it does not yet have as its sides two selves that exist as selves; for the state power is first animated into a self; this language is therefore not yet the spirit as it knows itself perfectly and expresses itself.
zh: 这两个极端，即国家权力和高贵的意识，通过这一点而被分解，前者分解为被服从的抽象普遍物，以及自为存在的意志，但这个意志本身还不属于它，——后者分解为被扬弃的定在的服从，或分解为自尊和荣誉的自在存在，以及尚未被扬弃的纯粹自为存在，即还留在埋伏中的那个意志。
两个方面被净化到其中、因而成为语言环节的那两个环节，就是被称为普遍福利的抽象普遍物，以及那个在服务中舍弃了自己那沉入杂多定在之中的意识的纯粹自我。
两者在概念中是同一个东西；因为纯粹自我恰恰就是抽象普遍物，所以它们的统一就被设定为它们的中项。
但自我还只是在意识的极端上才是现实的，——而自在则还只是在国家权力的极端上才是现实的；意识缺少这一点，即国家权力不只是作为荣誉、而是现实地已经转移到它身上；国家权力则缺少这一点，即人们服从它不只是作为所谓普遍福利，而是作为意志，或者说，它就是作出决断的自我。
国家权力还处于其中、而意识已把自己纯化到它那里的那个概念的统一，在这种中介运动中成为现实的，而这种中介运动的简单定在作为中项就是语言。
——不过，这种统一在它的两个方面还没有两个作为自我而存在着的自我；因为国家权力才刚刚被赋予精神而成为自我；所以这种语言还不是那种完全知道自己并把自己说出来的精神。

en: The noble consciousness, because it is the extreme of the self, appears as that from which language proceeds, through which the sides of the relation shape themselves into an animated whole.
– The heroism of the silent service becomes the heroism of flattery.

This speaking reflection of service constitutes the spiritual, self-dissolving middle and reflects back not only its own extreme into itself but also the extreme of the universal power into this extreme itself, and makes it, which is at first only in itself, into being-for-itself and into the singleness of self-consciousness.

Thereby the spirit of this power becomes to be an unrestricted monarch; – unrestricted: the language of flattery elevates the power into its purified universality, the moment, as product of language, of determinate being purified into spirit, is a purified self-equality;

– Monarch: it likewise elevates singleness to its summit; that of which the noble consciousness externalizes itself in this aspect of simple spiritual unity is the pure in-itself of its thinking, its I itself.

More determinately, it elevates singleness, which otherwise is only something meant, into its existing purity by giving the monarch his own name; for it is the name alone in which the difference of the individual from all others is not meant but is actually made by all; in the name the individual counts as purely individual no longer only in his own consciousness but in the consciousness of all.
Through it, therefore, the monarch is absolutely separated from all, excluded and solitary; in it he is the atom that can communicate nothing of its essence and has no equal.
– This name is herewith the reflection-into-itself, or the actuality that the universal power has on itself; through it, it is the monarch.

He, this single individual, conversely knows himself, this single individual, as the universal power through this: that the noble ones stand around the throne not only as ready for the service of the state power but as ornaments, and that they always say to him who sits on it what he is.
zh: 高贵的意识，因为它是自我的极端，就显现为语言由之出发的那个东西，而通过这种语言，这种关系的各个方面就把自己形成为有生气的整体。
——沉默的服务的英雄主义变成了谄媚的英雄主义。
服务的这种言说着的反思构成了精神的、自我分解着的中项，并且不仅把它自己的极端反思进自身之内，而且把普遍权力的极端也反思回到这个极端本身之中，并且把那个起初只是自在的权力变成自为存在，变成自我意识的个别性。
由此，这种权力的精神就是成为一个不受限制的君主；——不受限制：谄媚的语言把权力提升到它那被纯化了的普遍性之中，这一环节作为语言的产物、即作为被纯化成精神的定在的产物，是一种被净化了的自身等同性；
——君主：它同样把个别性提升到它的顶峰；高贵意识在简单精神统一这一方面所外化出去的东西，就是它思维的纯粹自在，就是它的我本身。
更确定地说，它把那种否则只是被意谓之物的个别性提升到它定在着的纯粹性之中，做法是给君主取他自己的名字；因为只有在名字中，个体与所有其他个体的差别才不是被意谓的，而是被所有人现实地造成的；在名字中，个体作为纯粹个体，不再只是在他自己的意识中有效，而是在所有人的意识中有效。
所以，通过名字，君主就被绝对地与所有人分离开来、被排除出去并陷于孤独；在名字中，他就是那个原子，它对自己本质中的任何东西都无法传达，也没有同类。
——这个名字因此就是自身反思，或者说就是普遍权力自身所具有的现实性；通过它，普遍权力才是君主。
他，这个个别人，反过来正因此才知道自己，这个个别人，就是普遍权力，即：高贵者们不只是作为准备为国家权力服务的人，而是作为装饰品围立在王座四周，并且总是对坐在其上的人说出他是什么。

en: The language of their praise is in this way the spirit that in the state power itself joins the two extremes together; it reflects the abstract power into itself and gives it the moment of the other extreme, the willing and deciding being-for-itself, and thereby self-conscious existence; or thereby this single actual self-consciousness comes to know itself with certainty as the power.
It is the point of the self into which, through the externalization of inner certainty, the many points have flowed together.

– But since this own spirit of the state power consists in having its actuality and nourishment in the sacrifice of the doing and thinking of the noble consciousness, it is self-estranged independence; the noble consciousness, the extreme of being-for-itself, receives back the extreme of actual universality for the universality of thinking, of which it externalized itself; the power of the state has passed over to it.
On it the state power is first truly put into action; in its being-for-itself it ceases to be the inert essence as it appeared as the extreme of abstract being-in-itself.

– Considered in itself, the state power reflected into itself, or this, that it has become spirit, means nothing other than that it has become a moment of self-consciousness, i.e. that it is only as sublated.
Herewith it is now the essence as such a one whose spirit it is to be sacrificed and given over, or it exists as wealth.

– It is true that it continues to subsist over against wealth, into which according to the concept it always becomes, at the same time as an actuality, but an actuality whose concept is precisely this movement: through the service and the veneration, whereby it becomes, to pass over into its opposite, into the externalization of power.

For itself, therefore, the peculiar self that is its will becomes, through the casting-off of the noble consciousness into self-externalizing universality, a perfect singleness and contingency that is given over to every more powerful will; what remains to it of universally recognized and non-communicable independence is the empty name.
zh: 他们赞美的那种语言，以这种方式就是那种在国家权力自身中把两个极端联结起来的精神；它把抽象权力反思进自身，并给予它另一个极端的环节，即意愿着并作出决断的自为存在，并由此给予它自我意识的存在；或者说，这个个别的、现实的自我意识由此才达到确信自己就是权力。
它就是自我的那个点，由于内心确定性的外化，许多点都汇流进了这个点。
——但是，既然国家权力这种特有的精神在于从高贵意识的行动和思想的牺牲中获得自己的现实性和养料，那么它就是自身异化了的独立性；高贵意识，即自为存在的极端，用它曾把自己外化出去的那种思维普遍性，换回了现实普遍性的极端；国家的权力已经转移到它身上。
在它身上，国家权力才真正被运用起来；在它的自为存在中，国家权力就不再是它作为抽象自在存在的极端所显现的那个惰性的本质。
——自在来看，在自身中反思了的国家权力，或者它已经成了精神这一点，无非意味着它已经成了自我意识的环节，也就是说，它只是作为被扬弃者而存在。
这样一来，它就是这样的本质，其精神在于被牺牲、被交出，或者，它作为财富而存在。
——诚然，它仍然与财富——按概念它总是变成财富——相对，同时又作为一种现实性持存着，但这是这样一种现实性，它的概念恰恰就是这一运动：通过服务和崇拜，即通过它借以生成的东西，过渡到它的反面，过渡到权力的外化。
所以，自为地看，那个作为它的意志的特有自我，就由于高贵意识把自己抛进自我外化的普遍性之中而变成一种完全的个别性和偶然性，这种个别性和偶然性被交给任何更强有力的意志；而它剩下的那种被普遍承认、却又不可传达的独立性，就是空洞的名字。

en: If, then, the noble consciousness determined itself as that which would comport itself toward the universal power in an equal way, the truth of it is rather, in its service, to keep for itself its own being-for-itself, but in the proper renunciation of its personality to be the actual sublation and tearing-apart of the universal substance.

Its spirit is the relation of complete inequality, on the one hand to keep its will in its honour, on the other hand, in the giving-up of this will, partly to estrange itself from its own inner being and to become the highest inequality with itself, partly to subject the universal substance to itself therein and to make it completely unequal to itself.
– It is evident that with this its determinacy, which it had in the judgment against the one called ignoble consciousness, and thereby this latter too, has vanished.
The latter has attained its end, namely to bring the universal power under being-for-itself.
zh: 所以，如果高贵意识把自己规定为那种以相等的方式对待普遍权力的意识，那么它的真理反倒在于，在它的服务中为自己保持自己的自为存在，而在真正放弃自己的人格性时则是对普遍实体的现实扬弃和撕裂。
它的精神就是完全不相等的这种关系，一方面在它的荣誉中保持自己的意志，另一方面在放弃这个意志时，一部分是使自己的内在东西与自己异化，并成为与自己的最高不相等，一部分是把普遍实体在这当中置于自己之下，并使它与自己完全不相等。
——由此可见，它曾在针对那个被称为卑贱意识的意识的判断中所具有的规定性，以及由此连这个意识本身，都已经消失了。
后者已经达到了它的目的，即把普遍权力置于自为存在之下。

en: Thus enriched through the universal power, self-consciousness exists as the universal benefaction, or the universal power is wealth, which itself in turn is an object for consciousness.
For it is for this consciousness the universal that is indeed subjugated, but which through this first sublation has not yet absolutely returned into the self.
– The self has as its object not yet itself as self, but the sublated universal essence.

Since this has only just come to be, the immediate relation of consciousness to it is posited, a consciousness that has therefore not yet exhibited its inequality with it; it is the noble consciousness, which on the universal that has become unessential retains its being-for-itself, hence recognizes it and is grateful toward the benefactor.
zh: 这样，自我意识通过普遍权力而变得富有，就作为普遍的善举而存在，或者说，这种普遍权力就是财富，而财富本身又成为意识的对象。
因为对意识来说，财富虽然是已被制服的普遍物，但通过这第一次扬弃，它还没有绝对地返回到自我之中。
——自我还没有把自己作为自我，而是把被扬弃的普遍本质作为自己的对象。
既然财富才刚生成，意识对它的直接关系就被设定了，所以这种意识还没有表现出自己与它的不相等；这就是高贵的意识，它在已经变得非本质的普遍物身上保持着自己的自为存在，因此承认财富，并对恩人心怀感激。

en: Wealth has in itself already the moment of being-for-itself.

It is not the selfless universal of the state power, or the ingenuous inorganic nature of spirit, but the state power as it through the will holds fast to itself against the one who wants to seize it for enjoyment.

But since wealth has only the form of essence, this one-sided being-for-itself, which is not in itself but rather the sublated in-itself, is the return of the individual into itself that is without essence in its enjoyment.

It therefore itself needs animation; and the movement of its reflection consists in this, that it, which is only for itself, becomes being-in-and-for-itself, that it, which is the sublated essence, becomes essence; in this way it obtains its own spirit in itself.
Since the form of this movement was set out just now, it is sufficient here to determine its content.
zh: 财富在它自己身上已经有了自为存在的环节。
它并不是国家权力那种无我的普遍物，也不是精神那种不偏不倚的无机自然，而是国家权力本身，即国家权力通过意志在自身那里坚持住自己，以对抗那个想占有它来供自己享受的人。
但是，既然财富只具有本质的形式，那么这种片面的自为存在，即不是自在、而毋宁是被扬弃了的自在，就是个体在享受中那种没有本质的返回自身。
所以它本身需要被赋予生气；而它的反思的运动就在于：它这个只是自为存在的东西要变成自在自为存在，它这个被扬弃的本质要变成本质；这样，它就在自己身上获得了自己的精神。
既然刚才已经阐述了这一运动的形式，那么在这里确定它的内容就足够了。

en: The noble consciousness therefore relates itself here not to the object as essence in general, but being-for-itself itself is something foreign to it; it finds its self as such estranged, as an objective, firm actuality that it has to receive from another firm being-for-itself.

Its object is being-for-itself, thus its own; but in that it is object, it is at the same time immediately a foreign actuality, which is its own being-for-itself, its own will, that is, it sees its self in the power of a foreign will, on which it depends whether that will will let it go.
zh: 所以，高贵的意识在这里不是与作为一般本质的对象发生关系，而是自为存在本身对它来说成了陌生的东西；它发现自己的自我本身已经异化，成了一种对象性的、固定的现实性，而它必须从另一个固定的自为存在那里领受这种现实性。
它的对象是自为存在，也就是它自己的东西；但正因为它成了对象，它同时直接就是一种陌生的现实性，而这种现实性就是它自己的自为存在、它自己的意志，也就是说，它看到自己的自我处在一个陌生意志的支配之下，而它取决于这个陌生意志是否愿意把自我让给它。

en: From every single side self-consciousness can abstract, and therefore in an obligation that concerns such a side it retains its being-recognized and its counting in itself as an essence that exists for itself.

Here, however, it sees itself from the side of its pure, ownmost actuality or of its I as outside itself and belonging to another, sees its personality as such dependent on the contingent personality of another, on the contingency of a moment, of an arbitrariness or otherwise of the most indifferent circumstance,

– In the legal condition, what is in the power of the objective essence appears as a contingent content from which abstraction can be made, and the power does not affect the self as such, but rather this self is recognized.
But here it sees the certainty of itself, as such the most essenceless, and pure personality, to be absolute impersonality.
The spirit of its thanks is therefore the feeling of this deepest abjection as also of the deepest indignation.

In that the pure I itself beholds itself outside itself and torn apart, in this tornness everything that has continuity and universality, whatever is called law, good and right, has at the same time fallen apart and gone to ruin; everything equal is dissolved, for the purest inequality, the absolute unessentiality of the absolutely essential, the being-outside-itself of being-for-itself is present; the pure I itself is absolutely decomposed.
zh: 自我意识可以从每一个个别的方面抽象出来，因此在涉及这样一个方面的约束中，它仍然保持着自己作为自为存在着的本质的被承认和自在有效。
但在这里，它从自己那纯粹而最本己的现实性、或者说从自己的我这个方面看到，自己在自身之外、属于另一个东西，看到自己的人格性本身依赖于另一个人的偶然的人格性，依赖于一个瞬间的偶然、一种任意或者别的什么最无关紧要的情况，
——在法权状态中，处在对象性本质的支配之下的东西，显现为一种可以从中抽象出来的偶然内容，而支配并不涉及自我本身，相反，这个自我倒是被承认的。
但在这里，它看到自己的确定性作为这样的东西乃是最无本质的，看到纯粹的人格性，都是绝对的非人格性。
所以，它感恩的精神就是既感到这种最深的堕落、也感到最深的愤慨的那种感情。
由于纯粹的我本身看到自己在自身之外、并且是撕裂的，在这种撕裂状态中，一切具有连续性和普遍性的东西、一切被称为法则、善和正当的东西，同时也都分崩离析、归于毁灭了；一切相等的东西都消解了，因为最纯粹的不相等、绝对本质之物的绝对非本质性、自为存在的自身之外存在都现成存在着；纯粹的我本身被绝对地分解了。

en: If, then, this consciousness indeed receives back from wealth the objectivity of being-for-itself and sublates it, it is not only according to its concept, like the preceding reflection, not completed, but is unsatisfied for itself; the reflection, since the self receives itself as something objective, is posited as the immediate contradiction in the pure I itself.

But as self it stands at the same time immediately above this contradiction, is the absolute elasticity that again sublates this sublatedness of the self, rejects this abjection, that its being-for-itself becomes something foreign to it, and, indignant against this receiving of itself, is for itself in the receiving itself.
zh: 所以，如果这种意识从财富那里确实重新获得了自为存在的对象性并把它扬弃掉，那么它就不只是像先前的反思那样按自己的概念还没有完成，而且对它自己来说也是不满足的；由于自我把自己领受为一个对象性的东西，这种反思就被设定为纯粹的我本身之中的直接矛盾。
但作为自我，它同时直接站在这一矛盾之上，是绝对的弹性，它重新扬弃自我的这种被扬弃状态，拒斥这种堕落，即它的自为存在变得对它是陌生的东西，并且，由于对这种领受自己感到愤慨，它就在这种领受本身中自为地存在着。

en: Since, then, the relation of this consciousness is bound up with this absolute tornness, in its spirit the difference of the same, that it is determined as noble over against the ignoble, falls away, and both are the same.
– Further, the spirit of the beneficent wealth can be distinguished from the spirit of the consciousness that receives the benefaction and is to be considered separately.
– It was the essenceless being-for-itself, the surrendered essence.

Through its imparting, however, it becomes the in-itself; in that it fulfilled its determination to sacrifice itself, it sublates the singleness of enjoying only for itself, and as sublated singleness it is universality or essence.
– What it imparts, what it gives to others, is being-for-itself.

But it does not give itself up as a selfless nature, as the ingenuous condition of life that gives itself over, but as a self-conscious essence that holds itself for itself; it is not the inorganic power of the element, which is known by the receiving consciousness as transient in itself, but the power over the self, which knows itself as independent and arbitrary and at the same time knows that what it dispenses is the self of another.
– Wealth therefore shares abjection with the client, but in place of indignation there steps arrogance.
For on the one side it knows being-for-itself, like the client, as a contingent thing; but it itself is this contingency, in whose power personality stands.

In this arrogance, which thinks it has received a foreign I-self through a meal and has thereby acquired the subjugation of its innermost essence, it overlooks the other's inner indignation; it overlooks the complete devaluation of every fetter, this pure tornness, in which, since the self-equality of being-for-itself has become absolutely unequal to it, everything equal, all subsistence is torn apart, and which therefore tears apart the benefactor's opinion and view most of all.

It stands immediately before this innermost abyss, before this bottomless depth in which all hold and substance have vanished; and it sees in this depth nothing but a common thing, a plaything of its mood, a contingency of its arbitrariness; its spirit is the wholly essenceless opinion of being the spirit-forsaken surface.
zh: 所以，既然这种意识的关系与这种绝对的撕裂状态联系在一起，那么它的精神中，它被规定为高贵的、与卑贱的相对立这一差别也就消失了，两者是同一个东西。
——此外，行善的财富的精神还可以与领受善举的意识的精神区分开来，并且要特别地加以考察。
——它曾经是无本质的自为存在，是被交出去的本质。
但是，通过它的分给，它变成了自在；在它履行了自己牺牲自己这一规定时，它就扬弃了只为自己享受的个别性，而作为被扬弃的个别性，它就是普遍性或本质。
——它分给别人的东西，它给予别人的东西，就是自为存在。
但是，它并不是作为无我的自然、作为不偏不倚地把自己交出去的生命条件而把自己交出去，而是作为自我意识的、自为地坚持自己的本质；它不是元素那种无机的权力，这种权力被领受的意识知道为自在就消逝着的东西，而是对自我的权力，这种权力知道自己独立而任意，并且同时知道，它分发出去的东西是另一个人的自我。
——所以，财富与门客分担这种堕落，但代替愤慨出现的是傲慢。
因为一方面，财富像门客一样，把自为存在知道为一种偶然之物；但财富本身就是这种偶然性，而人格就处在这种偶然性的支配之下。
在这种傲慢中，财富以为通过一顿饭就得到了一个陌生的我-自我，并由此赢得了对那个我-自我最内在本质的征服，于是它忽视了他人的内心愤慨；它忽视了一切束缚的完全贬值，忽视了这种纯粹的撕裂状态，在这种撕裂状态中，由于自为存在的自身等同对它来说已经变成绝对不相等的东西，一切相等的东西、一切持存都被撕裂了，所以这种撕裂状态最厉害地撕裂了恩人的意见和看法。
财富直接站在这最内在的深渊面前，站在这无底的深处面前，在这里，一切支撑和实体都消失了；而它在这深处看到的，无非是一件平常之物、它的心绪的一个玩物、它的任意的一种偶然；它的精神就是那种完全无本质的意见，即认为自己是失去精神的表面。

en: Just as self-consciousness had its language against the state power, or as spirit stepped forth between these extremes as the actual middle, so too it has language against wealth, but still more does its rebellion have its language.

That language which gives wealth the consciousness of its essentiality and thereby takes possession of it is likewise the language of flattery, but of the ignoble kind; – for what it expresses as essence, it knows as the surrendered essence, the essence that is not in itself.
But the language of flattery is, as was recalled earlier, the still one-sided spirit.
For its moments are indeed the self purified through the culture of service into pure existence, and the being-in-itself of the power.

But the pure concept, in which the simple self and the in-itself, that pure I and this pure essence or thought, are the same, – this unity of both sides, between which the interaction takes place, is not in the consciousness of this language; the object is for it still the in-itself in opposition to the self, or the object is for it not at the same time its own self as such.
– But the language of disruption is the perfect language and the true, existing spirit of this whole world of culture.

This self-consciousness, to which the rebellion that rejects its own abjection belongs, is immediately the absolute self-equality in absolute disruption, the pure mediation of pure self-consciousness with itself.
It is the equality of the identical judgment, in which one and the same personality is both subject and predicate.

But this identical judgment is at the same time the infinite one; for this personality is absolutely divided, and subject and predicate are utterly indifferent beings that have nothing to do with each other, without necessary unity, so much so that each is the power of its own personality.

Being-for-itself has its being-for-itself as object, as something utterly other and at the same time just as immediately as itself, – itself as an other, not that this had another content, but the content is the same self in the form of absolute opposition and of a completely own, indifferent determinate being.
– Thus there is present here the spirit of this real world of culture, conscious of itself in its truth and of its concept.
zh: 正如自我意识面对国家权力有自己的语言，或者精神作为现实的中项在这两个极端之间出现，它面对财富也有语言，而它的叛乱更是有自己的语言。
那种给财富以对其本质性的意识、并借此占有财富的语言，同样是谄媚的语言，只是不高贵的谄媚；——因为它作为本质说出来的东西，它知道那是被交出去的本质，并不是自在存在着的本质。
但谄媚的语言，正如前面已经提到过的，是仍然片面的精神。
因为它的环节固然是通过服务的教养而被纯化为纯粹存在的自我，以及权力的自在存在。
但纯粹概念，其中单纯的自我和自在、那个纯粹的我与这个纯粹的本质或思维是同一个东西，——双方的这个统一，双方之间发生着交互作用，并不在这种语言的意识里；对象对它来说还是与自我相对立的自在，或者说，对象对它来说并不同时是它自己的自我本身。
——但撕裂的语言是完善的语言，是这整个教养世界的真的、存在着的精神。
这种自我意识，那拒斥自身堕落的叛乱就属于它，它直接就是绝对撕裂中的绝对自身等同性，是纯粹自我意识与自身的纯粹中介。
它是同一判断的等同性，其中同一个人格既是主体又是谓词。
但这个同一判断同时又是无限的判断；因为这个人格是绝对分裂的，而主体和谓词是完全无关紧要的存在者，彼此毫不相干，没有必然的统一，甚至每一个都是它自己的人格的一种权力。
自为存在把自己的自为存在当作对象，当作一个完全的他者，同时又同样直接地当作它自己，——把自己当作一个他者，并不是说这个他者会有别的什么内容，相反，内容就是同一个自我，处在绝对对置和完全属于自己的、无关紧要的定在的形式中。
——所以这里就存在着这种实在的教养世界的、在其真理中意识到自身并意识到自己的概念的精神。

en: It is this absolute and universal inversion and estrangement of actuality and of thought; pure culture.

What is experienced in this world is that neither the actual essences of power and wealth nor their determinate concepts, good and bad, or the consciousness of the good and the bad, the noble-minded and the base, have truth; on the contrary, all these moments are rather inverted one in the other, and each is the opposite of itself.

– The universal power, which is substance in that through the principle of individuality it attains to its own spirituality, receives its own self only as the name upon it, and, since it is actual power, is rather the powerless essence that sacrifices itself.
– But this surrendered, selfless essence, or the self that has become a thing, is rather the return of the essence into itself; it is the being-for-itself that is for itself, the existence of spirit.
– The thoughts of these essences, of the good and the bad, are likewise inverted in this movement; what is determined as good is bad; what as bad, is good.

The consciousness of each of these moments, judged as the noble and the base consciousness, is in its truth rather just as much the reverse of what these determinations are supposed to be, the noble-minded one just as base and abject, as abjection turns into the nobility of the most cultivated freedom of self-consciousness.

– Everything is likewise, considered formally, outwardly the reverse of what it is for itself; and again, what it is for itself, it is not in truth, but something other than it wants to be; being-for-itself is rather the loss of itself, and its estrangement rather self-preservation.

– What is present, then, is this: that all moments exercise a universal justice against one another, that each estranges itself from itself just as much as it imagines itself into its opposite and in this way inverts it.
– But the true spirit is precisely this unity of the absolutely separated, and it comes into existence precisely through the free actuality of these selfless extremes themselves, as their middle.

Its determinate being is the universal speaking and the rending judgment, in which all those moments that are supposed to count as essences and actual members of the whole dissolve, and which is likewise this self-dissolving play with itself.
This judging and speaking is therefore the true and the unconquerable, while it overpowers everything; that which alone is truly at issue in this real world.
Every part of this world thereby comes to this, that its spirit is expressed, or that of it, with spirit, there is spoken and it is said of it what it is.
– The honest consciousness takes every moment as an enduring essentiality and is the uneducated thoughtlessness of not knowing that it does the reverse just as much.

But the torn consciousness is the consciousness of inversion, and indeed of absolute inversion; the concept is what rules in it, which brings together the thoughts that lie far apart for honesty, and whose language is therefore witty.
zh: 它就是现实性和思想的这种绝对的、普遍的颠倒和异化；纯粹教养。
在这个世界里经验到的，是无论权力和财富的现实的本质，还是它们的规定概念即善和恶，或者对善和恶的意识、即高尚的和卑贱的意识，都没有真理；相反，所有这些环节倒是在彼此之中颠倒过来，每一个都是它自己的反面。
——那普遍权力，它通过个体性的原则而达到自己的精神性，从而就是实体，它只是把它自己的自我当作自己身上的名字来接受，而由于它是现实的权力，它倒毋宁说是那牺牲自己的无力的本质。
——但这个被交出去的、无自我的本质，或者说变成了物的自我，倒毋宁说是本质向自身之中的返回；它是自为地存在着的自为存在，是精神的存在。
——这些本质、即善和恶的思想，在这种运动中也同样颠倒过来；被规定为善的，就是恶；被规定为恶的，就是善。
这些环节中每一个的意识，作为高贵的意识和卑贱的意识来评判，在它们的真理中倒同样都是这些规定所应是的东西的颠倒，那个高尚的同样卑贱、同样堕落，正如堕落转变为自我意识的最有教养的自由的高贵。
——一切从形式上看，在外部同样都是它自为地所是的东西的颠倒；而反过来，它自为地所是的东西，它真正说来并不是如此，而是它所想要是的某种别的东西；自为存在倒毋宁说是它自身的丧失，而它的异化倒毋宁说是自我保存。
——所以现有的情况就是：所有环节都彼此施行一种普遍的公正，每一个都同样既从自身异化出来，又把自己想象成自己的反面，并以此方式把它的反面颠倒过来。
——但真的精神恰恰就是这绝对分离者的统一，而且它正是通过这些无自我的极端的自由现实性本身，作为它们的中项而进入存在。
它的定在就是普遍的言说和撕裂性的判断，一切那些应当算作本质和整体的现实成员的东西，都在其中消解，而它同样就是这种自我消解着的、与自身进行的游戏。
这种判断和言说因此就是真的东西和不可制服的东西，而它压倒一切；就是在这个实在的世界中唯独真正事关紧要的那个东西。
这个世界的每一部分都由此达到：它的精神被说出来，或者说，人们以精神谈论它，并说出它是什么。
——诚实的意识把每一个环节都当作一种持存的本质性，它就是无教养的无思想性，不知道自己也同样做着颠倒的事。
但撕裂的意识是颠倒的意识，并且是绝对颠倒的意识；概念在它之中是起支配作用的东西，它把那些对诚实来说相距甚远的思想聚拢起来，因此它的语言是机智的。

en: The content of the spirit's speech about and concerning itself is therefore the perversion of all concepts and realities, the universal deceit of itself and of others; and the shamelessness of saying this deceit is for that very reason the greatest truth.

This speech is the madness of the musician who »heaped and mixed thirty arias, Italian, French, tragic, comic, of every kind of character; now with a deep bass he climbed down into hell, then he drew his throat together, and with a falsetto tone he tore apart the heights of the air …, by turns raging, calmed, imperious and mocking.«

– To the calm consciousness, which in an honest way puts the melody of the good and the true into the equality of tones, i.e. into one note, this speech appears as ›a drivel of wisdom and folly, as a mixture of just as much skill as baseness, of ideas just as correct as false, of a perversion of feeling so complete, of a vileness as perfect as it is complete openness and truth.

It will not be able to refuse to enter into all these tones and to run up and down the whole scale of feeling from the deepest contempt and rejection to the highest admiration and emotion; into these a ridiculous trait will be fused, which takes away their nature‹; those will have in their openness itself a reconciling trait, in their shattering depth the all-powerful trait that gives the spirit to itself.
zh: 所以，精神关于自己、并且对自己所说的那种话的内容，就是一切概念和实在性的颠倒，就是它自己和别人的普遍欺骗；而把这种欺骗说出来的无耻，正因如此就是最大的真理。
这种话就是那个音乐家的疯癫，他»把三十支咏叹调，意大利的、法国的、悲剧的、喜剧的、各种性格的，堆在一起、混在一起；一会儿用低沉的低音一直下到地狱里去，一会儿又把嗓子收紧，用假声撕破高空……，忽而狂怒，忽而平静，忽而命令，忽而嘲弄«。
——对于那种老老实实把善和真的旋律放进音调的相等性、也就是放进一个音符里的平静意识来说，这种话显得是›一种智慧和愚妄的胡言，是一种混合物——其中既有同样多的机巧又有同样多的卑下，既有同样正确的观念又有同样错误的观念，既有如此彻底的感情颠倒，又有如此完美的下流，同时又是完全的坦率和真理。
它不会不能进入所有这些音调，不会不能在从最深的蔑视和拒斥到最高的惊赞和感动的整个感情音阶上跑上跑下；在这些音调中将融进一种可笑的特色，它夺走了它们的本性‹；而那些音调则会在自己的坦率中带有一种和解的特色，在自己震撼人心的深度中带有那种把精神给予精神自身的全能特色。

en: If we compare the speech of that simple consciousness of the true and the good with the speech of this confusion that is clear to itself, then the former, against the open eloquence of the spirit of formation, of which it is itself conscious, can only be monosyllabic; for it cannot say to this spirit anything that it does not itself know and say.
If it goes beyond its monosyllabicness, then it says the same thing that he expresses, but in doing so it additionally commits the folly of meaning that it says something new and different.
Even its syllables, shameful, base, are already this folly, for that spirit says them of itself.

If this spirit in its speech perverts everything monotonous, because this selfsame is only an abstraction, but in its actuality is the perversion of itself, and if on the other hand the upright consciousness takes the good and the noble, i.e. that which holds itself equal in its expression, under protection in the only way that is possible here – namely that it does not lose its value because it is linked to the bad or mixed with it; for this is its condition and necessity, herein consists the wisdom of nature –, then this consciousness, in meaning to contradict, has thereby only summarized the content of the spirit's speech in a trivial way, which, thoughtlessly, in making the opposite of the noble and good into the condition and necessity of the noble and good, means to say something other than this: that what is called noble and good is in its essence the perversion of itself, just as the bad is conversely the excellent.
zh: 如果我们把那种对真和善的单纯意识所说的话，与这种自身清晰的混乱所说的话对照起来看，那么它面对教养精神那种公开的、并且自己意识到自身的雄辩，就只能是单音节的；因为它不能对这个精神说出任何它自己不知道、不说出的东西。
如果它超出了自己的单音节，那么它说的就是他说出的同一个东西，但在这当中还犯下一种愚蠢：意谓自己说出了某种新的、不同的东西。
就连它的那些音节——可耻、下贱——也已经是这种愚蠢，因为那个精神说这些话，说的就是它自己。

如果这个精神在它的话里把一切单调的东西都颠倒过来，因为这种自身相等的东西只是一个抽象，而在它的现实性中却是自身之内的颠倒，而如果相反地，正直的意识以这里唯一可能的方式为善和高贵的东西——即那种在自己的表现中保持自身相等的东西——辩护：就是说，它并不因此就失去自己的价值，因为它与坏的东西相联结，或者与它相混合；因为这是它的条件和必然性，自然的智慧就在于此——，那么这种意识在它意谓自己是在反驳的时候，恰恰只是把精神所说的话的内容以一种平庸的方式概括起来了，而这种概括无思想地，由于它把高贵和善的东西的反面变成高贵和善的东西的条件和必然性，就意谓自己说出了某种别的东西，而不是说出这一点：被称为高贵和善的东西在它的本质中就是它自身的颠倒，正如坏的东西反过来则是卓越的东西。

en: If the simple consciousness replaces this spiritless thought with the actuality of the excellent, by presenting the same in the example of a fabricated case or also of a true anecdote and thus showing that it is no empty name but is present, then the universal actuality of the perverse doing of the whole real world stands opposed to it, in which that example therefore constitutes only something wholly isolated, an Espèce; and to present the determinate being of the good and the noble as a single anecdote, be it fabricated or true, is the bitterest thing that can be said of it.

– If finally the simple consciousness demands the dissolution of this whole world of perversion, it cannot demand of the individual the removal out of it, for Diogenes in his tub is conditioned by it, and the demand made on the single individual is precisely what holds for the bad, namely to care for oneself as a single individual.

But addressed to universal individuality, the demand for this removal cannot have the meaning that reason again gives up the spiritual, cultured consciousness to which it has come, sinks the spread-out wealth of its moments back into the simplicity of the natural heart and falls back into the wilderness and nearness of animal consciousness, which nature is also called innocence; rather, the demand for this dissolution can only be directed at the spirit of formation itself, that it return to itself out of its confusion as spirit and win an even higher consciousness.
zh: 如果单纯的意识用卓越东西的现实性来替换这个无精神的思想，做法是把它展示在一个虚构的事例、或者一个真实轶事的例子里，从而表明它不是一个空洞的名字，而是存在着的，那么整个实在世界的颠倒行径的普遍现实性就与它相对立，那个例子在其中因此只构成某种完全个别的东西，一个 Espèce；而把善和高贵东西的定在表现为一个单独的轶事，不管它是虚构的还是真实的，都是关于它所能说的最刻毒的话。
——如果单纯的意识最后要求消解这整个颠倒的世界，那么它不能要求个体从这个世界中脱身出去，因为木桶里的第欧根尼正是由这个世界制约的，而对单个个人的要求恰恰就是适用于坏东西的那种要求，即作为单个个人为自己操心。
但对于普遍个体性来说，这种脱身的要求不可能具有这样的含义：理性重新放弃它已经达到的那种精神的、有教养的意识，把它那些环节的展开的财富重新沉回到自然之心的单纯性中去，并且退回到动物意识的荒野和近处，而这种自然也被称为无辜；相反，这种消解的要求只能针对教养的精神本身，即要它从自己的混乱中作为精神回到自身，并获得一种更高的意识。

en: But in fact the spirit has already accomplished this in itself.

The tornness of consciousness that is conscious of itself and expresses itself is the mocking laughter over determinate being as well as over the confusion of the whole and over itself; it is at the same time the still-heard dying-away of this whole confusion.

– This vanity, hearing itself, of all actuality and of every determinate concept is the doubled reflection of the real world into itself; once in this self of consciousness, as this one, the other time in the pure universality of the same, or in thinking.

According to that side, the spirit that has come to itself has directed its gaze into the world of actuality and still has it as its purpose and immediate content; according to the other, however, its gaze is partly only into itself and negative against that world, partly turned away from it toward heaven, and the beyond of that world is its object.
zh: 但实际上，精神已经自在地完成了这件事。
意识那种意识到自身、并把自己说出来的撕裂，就是对定在、对整体的混乱以及对自己的讥笑；它同时又是这整个混乱的那种还能听见的余音。
——这种自身听见的、一切现实性和一切特定概念的虚妄，就是实在世界在自身中的双重反思；一次是在意识的这个自我中，作为这一个自我，另一次是在它的纯粹普遍性中，或者说在思维中。
按前一方面，已经回到自身的精神把目光投向现实性的世界，并且还把它当作自己的目的和直接内容；但按另一方面，它的目光一部分只是朝向自身、并否定地对待这个世界，一部分则离开这个世界转向天空，而这个世界的彼岸就是它的对象。

en: In that side of the return into the self, the vanity of all things is its own vanity, or it is vain.

It is the self existing for itself that knows how to say everything not only in judging and chattering about it, but wittily to say the firm essences of actuality as well as the firm determinations that judgment posits, in their contradicting, and this contradiction is their truth.

– Considered according to the form, it knows everything estranged from itself, being-for-itself separated from being-in-itself, the meant and the purpose from the truth, and again from both, being-for-another; the pretended from the proper opinion and the true matter and intention.
– It therefore knows how to express each moment correctly against the other, in general the perversion of all; it knows better what each is than it is, let it be determined however it will.

Since it knows the substantial according to the side of disunity and of the conflict that it unites in itself, but not according to the side of this unity, it understands very well how to judge the substantial, but has lost the capacity to grasp it.
– This vanity needs for this the vanity of all things in order to give itself from them the consciousness of the self, therefore it produces them itself and is the soul that bears them.

Power and wealth are the highest purposes of its effort; it knows that through renunciation and sacrifice it forms itself into the universal, arrives at the possession of it and in this possession has universal validity; they are the actual recognized powers.
But this its validity is itself vain; and precisely in taking possession of them, it knows them not to be self-essences, but rather knows itself as their power, and them as vain.

That it is thus, in their possession itself, out of it, it presents in the witty speech, which is therefore its highest interest and the truth of the whole; in this speech this self, as this pure self that belongs neither to actual nor to thought determinations, becomes for itself spiritual, truly universally valid.

It is the self-tearing nature of all relations and the conscious tearing of them; but only as rebellious self-consciousness does it know its own tornness, and in this knowledge of the same it has immediately raised itself above it.

In that vanity all content becomes a negative that can no longer be grasped positively; the positive object is only the pure I itself, and the torn consciousness is in itself this pure self-equality of the self-consciousness that has come to itself.
zh: 在回到自身的那一方面，一切事物的虚妄就是它自己的虚妄，或者说，它就是虚妄的。
它就是那个自为存在着的自我，它不仅知道评判一切、空谈一切，而且知道机智地说出现实性的那些固定本质以及判断所设定的那些固定规定，说出它们之间的矛盾，而这种矛盾就是它们的真理。
——按形式来看，它知道一切都已与自身异化，知道自为存在与自在存在分离开来，被意谓的东西和目的与真理分离开来，又知道为他存在与这两者分离开来，被声称的东西与本来的意见、与真实的事情和意图分离开来。
——所以，它知道把每个环节都正确地对着另一个环节说出来，总之知道把一切颠倒说出来；它比每个东西本身更知道它是什么，不管它怎样被规定。
由于它只是从分歧和它自身中统一起来的冲突这一方面、而不是从这种统一性这一方面去认识实体性的东西，所以它很懂得评判实体性的东西，却已经失去了把握它的能力。
——这种虚妄在这里需要一切事物的虚妄，以便从它们那里给自己造出关于自我的意识，所以它自己产生这些虚妄，并且是承载它们的灵魂。
权力和财富是它努力的最高目的；它知道自己通过舍弃和牺牲把自己教养为普遍的东西，达到对它的占有，并且在这种占有中拥有普遍有效性；它们是现实的、被承认的权力。
但是它这种有效本身是虚妄的；而且正是在它占有它们的时候，它知道它们并不是自身本质，反而知道自己是它们的权力，而它们是虚妄的。
它在占有它们时自己却由此脱身出来，这一点它在机智的语言中表达出来，而这种语言因此就是它最高的旨趣和整体的真理；在这种语言中，这个自我，作为这个纯粹的、既不属于现实的规定也不属于被思维的规定的东西的自我，就使自己成为精神的、真正普遍有效的。
它是一切关系的那种自我撕裂的本性，也是对这些关系的有意识的撕裂；但它只有作为反抗的自我意识才知道自己的撕裂，而在对这种撕裂的知识中，它已经直接把自己提升到这种撕裂之上了。
在那虚妄中，一切内容都变成一个再也不能被肯定地把握的否定物；肯定的对象只是纯粹的我本身，而撕裂的意识自在地就是已经回到自身的自我意识的这种纯粹的自身相等性。
